  • Comfortable dealing with system complexity

  • Great sense of ownership

  • You enjoy pushing the limits of your knowledge and experience every day

  • Outstanding problem-solving and analytical skills

  • Enjoys working as part of a team and as a mentor


Nice to have:

  • Spring framework, microservices

Additional Information

title: Operations Support System Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Operations Support System Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About us

We’re a U.S.-based healthcare software company building workflow and AI tools for a complex, high-

impact corner of healthcare administration. Small, technical team. We automate anything that happens

twice.


The role

If a process repeats, your job is to automate it.

You’ll own the systems behind our internal operations, sales, onboarding, and executive support — from the SaaS stack to the Zoho ecosystem to the automations that tie them together. You’ll be expected to take a business problem, design a solution, ship it, and keep it running without hand-holding.


What you’ll own


Business systems & administration

• Manage user access, permissions, and subscriptions across our SaaS stack.

• Provision and deprovision accounts cleanly, with security and auditability in mind.

• Keep the environment organized, documented, and ready to scale.


Zoho architecture

• Design and maintain our Zoho ecosystem (CRM, Books, Analytics, and adjacent apps).

• Build systems that match how the business actually works — no forced workarounds.

• Improve data quality, reporting, and operational visibility.


Automation & AI workflows

• Build no-code and low-code automations in Make, Zapier, and similar tools.

• Hunt down repetitive workflows and eliminate them.

• Design AI-assisted processes that make work faster, more consistent, and more accurate.


Operational engineering

• Understand how leads, sales, billing, onboarding, and customer ops connect.

• Build systems that reflect those flows end-to-end.

• Be the human-in-the-loop when judgment or exception handling is required.


You should have

• Hands-on experience building operational systems on no-code / low-code platforms.

• Fluency with Make, Zapier, or equivalent automation tools.

• Real experience using modern AI tools inside production workflows.

• Excellent written and spoken English.

• The instinct to work independently and figure things out.


Bonus points for

• Zoho CRM / Books / Analytics experience.

• A track record supporting sales, ops, or CS teams.

• A portfolio of automations or systems actively running today.

• Startup or fast-moving environment experience.


What success looks like (first 90 days)

• Measurable reduction in manual operational work.

• Cleaner, better-documented internal systems.

• Automations that run reliably without constant babysitting.

• You’re the clear owner of our operational tech stack.


Logistics

• Full-time contractor

• Fully remote

• Compensation: R$6,000/month


How to apply

Send a short Loom walking us through one system or automation you built end-to-end. Cover:

1. The problem.

2. The solution you designed.

3. The tools you used.

  • We care more about what you’ve built than what’s on your résumé.

title: Engenheiro de dados S
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro de dados S em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Sobre a posição

Como parte de uma equipe global de tecnologia, o(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sênior atuará no desenvolvimento, manutenção e evolução de produtos de dados em ambiente Cloud. O profissional será responsável por projetar e implementar soluções de engenharia de dados, garantindo qualidade, confiabilidade e escalabilidade dos dados utilizados pela organização.


A posição exige forte atuação em projetos de dados utilizando plataformas como Azure e Snowflake, além de colaboração constante com arquitetos, times ágeis e stakeholders de negócio para entrega de soluções analíticas de alto valor.


Principais Responsabilidades

• Projetar, desenvolver e manter soluções de engenharia de dados em ambiente Cloud.

• Desenvolver pipelines de dados batch e streaming utilizando plataformas Azure e Snowflake.

• Implementar processos de extração, transformação e carga de dados (ETL/ELT) provenientes de múltiplas fontes.

• Garantir a qualidade, governança e integridade dos dados ao longo de todo o ciclo de processamento.

• Desenvolver e manter soluções utilizando Snowflake, dbt e tecnologias do ecossistema Azure.

• Construir e otimizar consultas SQL, procedures e rotinas de processamento de dados.

• Implementar integrações entre diferentes sistemas e fontes de dados corporativas.

• Participar de provas de conceito (POCs), avaliações técnicas e demonstrações de novas tecnologias.

Colaboração e Entrega de Projetos

• Trabalhar em conjunto com equipes de negócio, arquitetos de soluções e times técnicos para levantamento de requisitos e definição de soluções.

• Traduzir necessidades de negócio em modelos de dados, fluxos automatizados e soluções escaláveis.

• Garantir aderência às melhores práticas de arquitetura, desenvolvimento, governança e segurança de dados.

• Participar ativamente de cerimônias ágeis e processos de melhoria contínua.

DevOps e Qualidade

• Atuar seguindo práticas de CI/CD, DevOps e padrões de desenvolvimento estabelecidos pela organização.

• Utilizar ferramentas de versionamento e gestão de código-fonte, como GitHub e Azure DevOps.

• Apoiar processos de automação, testes e monitoramento das soluções desenvolvidas.

• Contribuir para a evolução contínua da plataforma de dados e das práticas de engenharia adotadas pela equipe.


Requisitos Obrigatórios

• Experiência sólida em Engenharia de Dados (mínimo de 5 anos).

• Experiência prática com Snowflake.

• Conhecimento sólido em SQL, incluindo consultas complexas e stored procedures.

• Conhecimento sólido em dbt (Data Build Tool).

• Experiência na construção e manutenção de pipelines ETL/ELT em ambiente Cloud.

• Experiência com serviços Azure, incluindo ADF, Functions, Event Hub e Azure DevOps.

• Conhecimento em Python para desenvolvimento e automação de processos de dados.

• Conhecimento de modelagem de dados

• Experiência com práticas de CI/CD, DevOps e versionamento de código utilizando GitHub.

• Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum e/ou Kanban).

• Inglês avançado para comunicação em ambiente corporativo global.

Diferenciais

• Experiência com ferramentas de replicação de dados, como Qlik Replicate, SLT ou Click.

• Experiência em projetos de Data & Analytics.

• Conhecimento em SQL Server e otimização de consultas.

• Conhecimento em ferramentas de visualização de dados, como Power BI ou Tableau será um diferencial.

• Experiência com plataformas de streaming de dados, como Kafka.

title: Desenvolvedor Java FullStack Sr
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor Java FullStack Sr em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Na Mirante Tecnologia, acreditamos que a inovação e a excelência técnica são fundamentais para transformar negócios e gerar valor para nossos clientes. Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Java Full Stack Sênior para atuar em projetos estratégicos, contribuindo para o desenvolvimento de soluções robustas, escaláveis e de alto impacto.


O que esperamos desta posição:

  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações corporativas utilizando tecnologias Java e Web;
  • Atuar em todas as etapas do ciclo de desenvolvimento de software;
  • Participar da definição de soluções técnicas e arquitetura de sistemas;
  • Desenvolver integrações entre aplicações e bancos de dados;
  • Garantir a qualidade do código por meio de boas práticas, testes e revisão técnica;
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares em ambientes ágeis;
  • Apoiar a evolução contínua dos sistemas e processos de desenvolvimento.


Buscamos profissionais com conhecimento em:

  • Java;
  • EJB, JPA, JSF e Hibernate;
  • Orientação a Objetos e UML;
  • Desenvolvimento JEE;
  • HTML, CSS e JavaScript;
  • Padrões de Projeto (Design Patterns);
  • SQL ANSI;
  • MS SQL Server e/ou IBM DB2;
  • Servidores de Aplicação;
  • Integração Contínua (CI/CD);
  • Testes Unitários.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência em projetos de grande porte;
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de versionamento de código;
  • Experiência com modernização e evolução de aplicações corporativas.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Valorizamos a diversidade e acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas tornam nossas equipes mais fortes e inovadoras. Esta oportunidade também é destinada a Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). ♿

Se você busca desafios técnicos, desenvolvimento profissional e a oportunidade de atuar em projetos relevantes, venha fazer parte do nosso time!

title: Franqueado
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Franqueado em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Descrição do Cargo Estamos procurando um Franqueado para integrar a equipe da BT AGRO BRASIL. Este cargo tem como principais responsabilidades a gestão e operação de uma franquia, incluindo o planejamento estratégico, controle financeiro e desenvolvimento de estratégias de vendas locais. title: Desenvolvedor AEM, Senior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor AEM, Senior em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who Are We.


Newfold Digital is a leading web technology company serving nearly seven million customers globally. Established in 2021 through the combination of leading web services providers Endurance Web Presence and Web.com Group, our portfolio of brands includes: Bluehost, BigRock, ResellerClub, CrazyDomains, HostGator, Network Solutions, Register.com, Web.com and many others.


We help customers of all sizes build a digital presence that delivers results. With our extensive product offerings and personalized support, we take pride in collaborating with our customers to serve their online presence needs.


What you’ll do & how you’ll make your mark.

  • Develop and maintain reusable front-end components in Adobe Experience Manager (AEM).
  • Work with AEM components and templates, including integrating front-end code with AEM's rendering system.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including designers, back-end developers to deliver digital experiences.


Who you are & what you’ll need to succeed.

  • Advanced English skills .
  • Strong proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, and responsive web design principles.
  • Experience integrating Front-end code with AEM components, templates, and workflows.
  • Familiarity with AEM Sightly (HTL) and Sling models and AEM ecosystem.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively in a team environment.


Why you'll love us

  • We offer a 100% remote position with a monthly home office allowance of R$180.00 and an additional allowance for purchasing items for your office.
  • We provide Meal Vouchers or Food Vouchers worth R$44.55 per working day.
  • Health and dental insurance with no co-payment for employees.
  • Well-being program: Gympass, online meditation, and telemedicine!
  • Do you have a dog, cat, rabbit, hamster, goat, turtle, or even a mini dragon? We have a partnership for pet health insurance!
  • Educational platform: you can pursue undergraduate and graduate degrees, language courses (and much more!) at over 100 educational institutions for a very affordable price!
  • Life insurance.
  • Free website hosting.

description:

title: Sr. Software Engineer II - Data Solutions & Measurement
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Sr. Software Engineer II - Data Solutions & Measurement em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Cint is a global software leader in technology-enabled digital insights and research technology. The Cint platform automates the insights-gathering process so that companies can gain access to insights faster with unparalleled scale. Cint has one of the world’s largest consumer networks for digital survey-based research, made up of over 239 million engaged respondents across more than 130 countries. Over 4,600 insights-driven companies use Cint to accelerate how they gather consumer insights and supercharge business growth.

Job Description

The Team

The Cint Technology team is looking for a Senior Software Engineer II to join our international Measurement team. This position is for a software engineer who likes challenges. Our business has been doubling in the last few years, and so our systems need to scale to accommodate this growth.

What You Will Do

Our ideal candidate considers themselves among the highly technical and likes to push the limits of their knowledge and experience every day. In this role, you will work on designing, implementing, scaling, and maintaining the code that powers our production systems. With great freedom to innovate, you will play a key role in world-class research building the next generation of Cint products.

This is a remote opportunity for all over the country!

Qualifications

  • Strong and seasoned hands-on professional backend software development experience

  • Degree in Computer Science or related field

  • Proficient programming skills in Java

  • Comfortable maintaining Python code legacy

  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and testing frameworks

  • Experience with API integration

  • Experience with AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, SQL

  • Comfortable dealing with system complexity

  • Great sense of ownership

  • You enjoy pushing the limits of your knowledge and experience every day

  • Outstanding problem-solving and analytical skills

  • Enjoys working as part of a team and as a mentor


Nice to have:

  • Spring framework, microservices

  • Background in data analytics tools such as Spark, Hive, Databricks, or similar

Additional Information


Our Values

Collaboration is our superpower

  • We uncover rich perspectives across the world
  • Success happens together
  • We deliver across borders.

Innovation is in our blood

  • We’re pioneers in our industry
  • Our curiosity is insatiable
  • We bring the best ideas to life.

We do what we say

  • We’re accountable for our work and actions
  • Excellence comes as standard
  • We’re open, honest and kind, always.

We are caring

  • We learn from each other’s experiences
  • Stop and listen; every opinion matters
  • We embrace diversity, equity and inclusion.


More About Cint

We’re proud to be recognised in Newsweek’s 2025 Global Top 100 Most Loved Workplaces®, reflecting our commitment to a culture of trust, respect, and employee growth.

In June 2021, Cint acquired Berlin-based GapFish – the world’s largest ISO certified online panel community in the DACH region – and in January 2022, completed the acquisition of US-based Lucid – a programmatic research technology platform that provides access to first-party survey data in over 110 countries.

Cint Group AB (publ), listed on Nasdaq Stockholm, this growth has made Cint a strong global platform with teams across its many global offices, including Stockholm, London, New York, New Orleans, Singapore, Tokyo and Sydney. (

title: Executive Assistant
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Executive Assistant em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Executive Assistant to a US CEO — Sales-Driven, Self-Starters Only

Read this whole thing before you apply. It's a filter.

We place Executive Assistants with US home-service business owners. You won't be a task-rabbit. You'll be the CEO's right hand — the person who moves the needle on whatever the business needs that week.


Your #1 job: make sure deals close. Appointment setting, direct sales, follow-up that doesn't quit. From there it widens — hiring providers, dispatching, customer satisfaction, finding new ways to grow the business. We're not hiring an assistant. We're hiring a mini-CEO who makes the big CEO's life bigger.


This role is for people who take the reins. Nobody is going to hand you a checklist every morning. You see the gap, you close the gap. If you need to be told what to do next, stop reading — this will frustrate both of us.


The pay grows when you do:

  • Start at $1,000/mo
  • Hit your first KPI → $1,250/mo
  • Hit the next → $1,400/mo
  • Performance bonuses from the business owner on top — up to $400/mo more

The ceiling moves because you move it. We don't cap people who produce.


What you need to have:

  • Fluent, clear, neutral English — easy for a US homeowner to understand on a call
  • Proven sales or appointment-setting background (show us the receipts)
  • Comfortable owning a number, not just doing tasks
  • Cold calling is a plus, not a must


The non-negotiables — apply only if these are a yes:

  • Available across all US time zones (PST/CST/MST/EST)
  • Up to 50 hours/week. This is firm.
  • Saturday mornings when the business needs it
  • Comfortable with Hubstaff time tracking. We use it for transparency, not to micromanage or punish — that's not how we operate. But it's part of the job.


If you read the hours and the ownership bar and felt more interested, not less — you're who we're looking for. Hit Easy Apply. If you're a fit, we'll come back to you fast — we move quick when we find the right person.

title: System Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para System Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Systems Engineer II


*Please Read*

Duration: This is expected to be a 12 month engagement with extensions

Location: Remote

Notice Period: Cannot be longer than 2 weeks

Pay: 17.40/hr to 21.13/hr USD or $2,784 to $3,380 USD per month


Systems Engineer II


Must Haves:

• 5+ years of experience managing and developing core infrastructure

• 5+ years of experience with VMware vSphere and Horizon, Windows and Linux servers, and server hardware

• Strong PowerShell experience automating installs, modifying registry and files, and hardening Windows environments including Windows 11 and Server 2019 and 2022

• Experience with cloud services, SSO and MFA tools such as Okta, Microsoft Authenticator, and Duo

• Proficient in managing and troubleshooting secure Windows environments including Active Directory and Azure AD

• Experience with Terraform

• Strong IT operations and engineering background with solid communication and project execution skills


Day to Day:

You will assess, design, and maintain enterprise systems and infrastructure while troubleshooting issues and driving improvements. Responsibilities include automating processes with PowerShell and Terraform, managing server and application environments, supporting system upgrades and migrations, and ensuring performance and availability across IT systems. You will partner with vendors and internal teams, manage change processes, remediate vulnerabilities, and support compliance efforts while serving as an escalation point and mentoring team members.

title: AI Technical Lead Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Technical Lead Engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

I’m helping FreightPOP find a top candidate to join their team full-time for the role of AI Technical Lead Engineer.


You'll architect and lead AI product development, transforming logistics with intelligent automation.


Compensation:

USD 7K - 16K/month


Location:

Remote (for Mexico, Brazil, Argentina, and United States residents)


Mission of FreightPOP:

\"We simplify and streamline the transportation management experience for manufacturers, distributors, retailers, and 3PL’s by reducing friction and connecting systems for a seamless and optimal supply chain.\"


What makes you a strong candidate:

  • You have +8 years experience in Software development.
  • You have +6 years experience in SDLC (Software development life cycle).
  • You are proficient in AI agents, AI product development, AWS, Machine learning.
  • English - Fully fluent.


Responsibilities and more:

Compensation will vary based on Location. Central and South America in the range of $7k to $10k per month. In the US the range will be $12k to $16k per month. Skill and experinece based.


Essential Job Functions/Requirements:


AI Product Development & Technical Leadership:

  • Lead the technical execution of FreightPOP’s AI product initiatives and roadmap.
  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering leadership to define and deliver AI-powered capabilities across the platform.
  • Architect and guide development of AI solutions including copilots, agents, optimization engines, and intelligent automation.
  • Ensure AI initiatives align with business priorities and deliver measurable value to customers.


Solution Architecture & Platform Integration:

  • Define technical architecture and development standards for AI-powered capabilities.
  • Evaluate and select appropriate AI/ML tools, frameworks, vector databases, and supporting infrastructure.
  • Ensure solutions meet requirements for scalability, reliability, security, and cost efficiency.
  • Guide integration of AI decisioning with FreightPOP’s core platform systems, including logistics workflows, databases, and operational services.


Hands-on Development & Technical Oversight:

  • Act as a hands-on contributor while leading technical direction for AI initiatives.
  • Prototype and validate AI concepts before scaling into production-ready solutions.
  • Review implementations to ensure alignment with architectural guidance and engineering best practices.
  • Provide technical mentorship and direction to engineers contributing to AI initiatives.


AI Innovation & Continuous Improvement:

  • Continuously evaluate emerging AI technologies, tools, and methodologies.
  • Champion experimentation and innovation within the engineering organization.
  • Identify opportunities to improve FreightPOP’s platform through AI-driven automation, optimization, and intelligent decision support.


Cross-Functional Collaboration & Agile Execution:

  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Infrastructure teams to deliver AI capabilities rapidly and effectively.
  • Support rapid iteration cycles typical of AI development.
  • Help guide development practices that balance experimentation speed with production reliability.


Job Qualifications:


Education:

  • STEM bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.


Experience:

  • 8+ years software development experience with SaaS technology.
  • 6+ years SDLC in an Agile / SCRUM environment.
  • 4+ years in a Senior or Lead engineering role.
  • Experience building or integrating AI-powered products or platforms.
  • Experience designing scalable distributed systems.
  • Logistics or supply chain experience a plus.


Technology Environment:

  • FreightPOP’s platform is built on a modern SaaS architecture leveraging technologies including:
  • Backend: C#, .NET APIs and services.
  • Frontend: React (TypeScript-based UI).
  • Database: Microsoft SQL Server.
  • Cloud & Infrastructure: Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services (AWS).
  • The AI Tech Lead will work within this environment while introducing and integrating modern AI technologies such as large language model APIs, AI agents, vector databases, and AI orchestration frameworks as part of FreightPOP’s evolving platform architecture.


Skills & Expertise:

  • Passion for leveraging AI tools and emerging technologies.
  • Strong understanding of modern AI ecosystems (LLMs, MCPs, agents, embeddings, vector databases).
  • Experience building AI-powered software systems or integrating AI capabilities into applications.
  • Experience designing scalable SaaS architectures and distributed systems.
  • Ability to rapidly prototype and iterate AI solutions.
  • Strong problem-solving and technical decision-making skills.
  • Experience in evaluating and adopting new technologies.
  • Strong oral and written communication skills.
  • Ability to collaborate across product, engineering, and leadership teams, including in distributed team environments.


Other Abilities:

  • Strong curiosity and passion for AI innovation.
  • Ability to work effectively in fast-paced and evolving technical environments.
  • Self-driven problem solver capable of working with ambiguity and rapidly evolving requirements.
  • Commitment to continuous learning and staying current with emerging technologies.

title: Software Application Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Software Application Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

***Please send your CV in English


About Foretellix:

Foretellix is the gold standard for data-driven autonomy development toolchains. Foretellix’s Foretify™ toolchain enables a measurable, efficient, and trusted path to safe and scalable autonomy that helps you launch with confidence. Building on its industry leading V&V technology, Foretellix is enabling the AI autonomy revolution.


Role Description:

Be part of the Application Engineering Team responsible for adapting and deploying Foretellix verification & validation solutions to our customers and making them successful at their mission to provide next-gen ADAS/AV products. Our Application Engineers have a unique mix of ADAS/AV domain knowledge, software expertise, creativity, and the ability to work closely with customers to maximize the impact our solution can have on their ability to deliver high quality, safe products.

title: Assistente de gestão de projetos
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Assistente de gestão de projetos em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

NÍVEL PLENO - OPERAÇÕES, FLUXOS E ATENDIMENTO


O que esperamos desta profissional na Alter

Buscamos uma profissional que enxergue a operação como um sistema vivo.

Mais do que controlar tarefas, queremos alguém capaz de entender a lógica dos projetos, antecipar conflitos de agenda, equilibrar a carga de trabalho da equipe e garantir que cada cliente tenha uma experiência organizada, transparente e eficiente.

Ela será uma das principais guardiãs dos processos da Alter, ajudando a transformar planejamento em execução e execução em resultados.


Compromisso com Diversidade e Inclusão

Esta vaga é destinada prioritariamente a mulheres negras, como parte da estratégia da Alter de ampliar a presença de profissionais negras em funções técnicas, de coordenação e liderança.

A Alter acredita que equipes diversas produzem melhores soluções, ampliam perspectivas e fortalecem a capacidade de inovação e transformação da comunicação.


Objetivo da posição

Garantir a organização, fluidez e eficiência da operação da Alter, atuando como elo entre clientes, equipe e lideranças. A profissional será responsável por coordenar cronogramas, distribuir demandas, acompanhar entregas, monitorar prazos e apoiar o atendimento aos clientes, assegurando qualidade, produtividade e alinhamento entre todas as áreas envolvidas.

Na prática, esta posição funciona como uma combinação entre gestão de projetos, tráfego interno, coordenação operacional e atendimento , sendo peça-chave para a sustentação da rotina da agência.


Principais responsabilidades

Gestão de Projetos e Operações

  • Elaborar, atualizar e monitorar cronogramas de projetos.
  • Estruturar planos de trabalho e fluxos de execução.
  • Garantir o cumprimento de prazos e entregas.
  • Identificar gargalos, riscos e desvios de cronograma.
  • Apoiar lideranças na priorização de demandas.
  • Coordenar múltiplos projetos simultaneamente.

Tráfego Interno

  • Distribuir atividades entre as equipes de conteúdo, imprensa, design, audiovisual e marketing.
  • Controlar capacidade produtiva e ocupação da equipe.
  • Acompanhar status de execução das tarefas.
  • Cobrar atualizações e garantir visibilidade sobre o andamento dos projetos.
  • Apoiar o planejamento de férias, ausências e remanejamento de recursos.

Atendimento e Relacionamento com Clientes

  • Participar de reuniões de alinhamento.
  • Registrar e organizar demandas dos clientes.
  • Produzir atas, encaminhamentos e planos de ação.
  • Realizar acompanhamento cotidiano dos projetos.
  • Garantir que expectativas, escopo e cronogramas estejam alinhados entre cliente e equipe.

Processos e Melhoria Contínua

  • Apoiar a implementação e evolução de processos internos.
  • Alimentar ferramentas de gestão.
  • Produzir relatórios de acompanhamento.
  • Sugerir melhorias operacionais.
  • Contribuir para a padronização de fluxos, documentos e rotinas.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Formação em Comunicação, Administração, Marketing, Relações Públicas, Gestão de Projetos ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia em agências de comunicação, marketing ou consultorias.
  • Vivência em gestão de projetos e atendimento.
  • Excelente organização e capacidade de planejamento.
  • Domínio de ferramentas de gestão de projetos.

Conhecimento obrigatório em:

  • Trello
  • ClickUp
  • Google Workspace
  • Excel ou Google Sheets


Diferenciais

  • Certificação em metodologias ágeis.
  • Conhecimento em gestão de capacidade produtiva (HH).
  • Experiência em projetos de comunicação corporativa.
  • Vivência com clientes de sustentabilidade, terceiro setor ou organismos internacionais.
  • Conhecimento básico de CRM.
  • Familiaridade com Inteligência Artificial aplicada à produtividade e gestão, ESPECIALMENTE CLAUDE.


Competências comportamentais

Organização extrema

Consegue administrar simultaneamente dezenas de entregas, projetos e interlocutores sem perder controle de prioridades.

Capacidade de coordenação

Tem habilidade para mobilizar pessoas, cobrar retornos e manter os projetos em movimento sem gerar ruídos desnecessários.

Comunicação clara

Consegue traduzir demandas, alinhar expectativas e facilitar a comunicação entre diferentes áreas.

Senso de urgência

Entende a diferença entre o que é importante, urgente e estratégico.

Proatividade

Antecipar problemas é mais importante do que reagir a eles.

Inteligência relacional

Lida bem com clientes, equipes multidisciplinares e diferentes estilos de trabalho.


Indicadores de desempenho

  • Percentual de entregas realizadas dentro do prazo.
  • Taxa de retrabalho.
  • Cumprimento dos cronogramas dos projetos.
  • Satisfação dos clientes.
  • Nível de ocupação e distribuição equilibrada da equipe.
  • Tempo médio de resposta às demandas.
  • Qualidade dos registros, atas e controles operacionais.
  • Redução de gargalos e atrasos recorrentes.

title: System Engineer
description:

Systems Engineer II


*Please Read*

Duration: This is expected to be a 12 month engagement with extensions

Location: Remote

Pay: 17.40/hr to 21.13/hr USD or $2,784 to $3,380 USD per month

title: AI Technical Lead Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Technical Lead Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

I’m helping FreightPOP find a top candidate to join their team full-time for the role of AI Technical Lead Engineer.


You'll architect and lead AI product development, transforming logistics with intelligent automation.


Compensation:

USD 7K - 16K/month


Location:

Remote (for Mexico, Brazil, Argentina, and United States residents)


Mission of FreightPOP:

\"We simplify and streamline the transportation management experience for manufacturers, distributors, retailers, and 3PL’s by reducing friction and connecting systems for a seamless and optimal supply chain.\"


What makes you a strong candidate:

  • You have +8 years experience in Software development.
  • You have +6 years experience in SDLC (Software development life cycle).
  • You are proficient in AI agents, AI product development, AWS, Machine learning.
  • English - Fully fluent.


Responsibilities and more:

Compensation will vary based on Location. Central and South America in the range of $7k to $10k per month. In the US the range will be $12k to $16k per month. Skill and experinece based.


Essential Job Functions/Requirements:


AI Product Development & Technical Leadership:

  • Lead the technical execution of FreightPOP’s AI product initiatives and roadmap.
  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering leadership to define and deliver AI-powered capabilities across the platform.
  • Architect and guide development of AI solutions including copilots, agents, optimization engines, and intelligent automation.
  • Ensure AI initiatives align with business priorities and deliver measurable value to customers.


Solution Architecture & Platform Integration:

  • Define technical architecture and development standards for AI-powered capabilities.
  • Evaluate and select appropriate AI/ML tools, frameworks, vector databases, and supporting infrastructure.
  • Ensure solutions meet requirements for scalability, reliability, security, and cost efficiency.
  • Guide integration of AI decisioning with FreightPOP’s core platform systems, including logistics workflows, databases, and operational services.


Hands-on Development & Technical Oversight:

  • Act as a hands-on contributor while leading technical direction for AI initiatives.
  • Prototype and validate AI concepts before scaling into production-ready solutions.
  • Review implementations to ensure alignment with architectural guidance and engineering best practices.
  • Provide technical mentorship and direction to engineers contributing to AI initiatives.


AI Innovation & Continuous Improvement:

  • Continuously evaluate emerging AI technologies, tools, and methodologies.
  • Champion experimentation and innovation within the engineering organization.
  • Identify opportunities to improve FreightPOP’s platform through AI-driven automation, optimization, and intelligent decision support.


Cross-Functional Collaboration & Agile Execution:

  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Infrastructure teams to deliver AI capabilities rapidly and effectively.
  • Support rapid iteration cycles typical of AI development.
  • Help guide development practices that balance experimentation speed with production reliability.


Job Qualifications:


Education:

  • STEM bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.


Experience:

  • 8+ years software development experience with SaaS technology.
  • 6+ years SDLC in an Agile / SCRUM environment.
  • 4+ years in a Senior or Lead engineering role.
  • Experience building or integrating AI-powered products or platforms.
  • Experience designing scalable distributed systems.
  • Logistics or supply chain experience a plus.


Technology Environment:

  • FreightPOP’s platform is built on a modern SaaS architecture leveraging technologies including:
  • Backend: C#, .NET APIs and services.
  • Frontend: React (TypeScript-based UI).
  • Database: Microsoft SQL Server.
  • Cloud & Infrastructure: Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services (AWS).
  • The AI Tech Lead will work within this environment while introducing and integrating modern AI technologies such as large language model APIs, AI agents, vector databases, and AI orchestration frameworks as part of FreightPOP’s evolving platform architecture.


Skills & Expertise:

  • Passion for leveraging AI tools and emerging technologies.
  • Strong understanding of modern AI ecosystems (LLMs, MCPs, agents, embeddings, vector databases).
  • Experience building AI-powered software systems or integrating AI capabilities into applications.
  • Experience designing scalable SaaS architectures and distributed systems.
  • Ability to rapidly prototype and iterate AI solutions.
  • Strong problem-solving and technical decision-making skills.
  • Experience in evaluating and adopting new technologies.
  • Strong oral and written communication skills.
  • Ability to collaborate across product, engineering, and leadership teams, including in distributed team environments.


Other Abilities:

  • Strong curiosity and passion for AI innovation.
  • Ability to work effectively in fast-paced and evolving technical environments.
  • Self-driven problem solver capable of working with ambiguity and rapidly evolving requirements.
  • Commitment to continuous learning and staying current with emerging technologies.

title: AI Technical Lead Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Technical Lead Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

I’m helping FreightPOP find a top candidate to join their team full-time for the role of AI Technical Lead Engineer.


You'll architect and lead AI product development, transforming logistics with intelligent automation.


Compensation:

USD 7K - 16K/month


Location:

Remote (for Mexico, Brazil, Argentina, and United States residents)


Mission of FreightPOP:

\"We simplify and streamline the transportation management experience for manufacturers, distributors, retailers, and 3PL’s by reducing friction and connecting systems for a seamless and optimal supply chain.\"


What makes you a strong candidate:

  • You have +8 years experience in Software development.
  • You have +6 years experience in SDLC (Software development life cycle).
  • You are proficient in AI agents, AI product development, AWS, Machine learning.
  • English - Fully fluent.


Responsibilities and more:

Compensation will vary based on Location. Central and South America in the range of $7k to $10k per month. In the US the range will be $12k to $16k per month. Skill and experinece based.


Essential Job Functions/Requirements:


AI Product Development & Technical Leadership:

  • Lead the technical execution of FreightPOP’s AI product initiatives and roadmap.
  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering leadership to define and deliver AI-powered capabilities across the platform.
  • Architect and guide development of AI solutions including copilots, agents, optimization engines, and intelligent automation.
  • Ensure AI initiatives align with business priorities and deliver measurable value to customers.


Solution Architecture & Platform Integration:

  • Define technical architecture and development standards for AI-powered capabilities.
  • Evaluate and select appropriate AI/ML tools, frameworks, vector databases, and supporting infrastructure.
  • Ensure solutions meet requirements for scalability, reliability, security, and cost efficiency.
  • Guide integration of AI decisioning with FreightPOP’s core platform systems, including logistics workflows, databases, and operational services.


Hands-on Development & Technical Oversight:

  • Act as a hands-on contributor while leading technical direction for AI initiatives.
  • Prototype and validate AI concepts before scaling into production-ready solutions.
  • Review implementations to ensure alignment with architectural guidance and engineering best practices.
  • Provide technical mentorship and direction to engineers contributing to AI initiatives.


AI Innovation & Continuous Improvement:

  • Continuously evaluate emerging AI technologies, tools, and methodologies.
  • Champion experimentation and innovation within the engineering organization.
  • Identify opportunities to improve FreightPOP’s platform through AI-driven automation, optimization, and intelligent decision support.


Cross-Functional Collaboration & Agile Execution:

  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Infrastructure teams to deliver AI capabilities rapidly and effectively.
  • Support rapid iteration cycles typical of AI development.
  • Help guide development practices that balance experimentation speed with production reliability.


Job Qualifications:


Education:

  • STEM bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.


Experience:

  • 8+ years software development experience with SaaS technology.
  • 6+ years SDLC in an Agile / SCRUM environment.
  • 4+ years in a Senior or Lead engineering role.
  • Experience building or integrating AI-powered products or platforms.
  • Experience designing scalable distributed systems.
  • Logistics or supply chain experience a plus.


Technology Environment:

  • FreightPOP’s platform is built on a modern SaaS architecture leveraging technologies including:
  • Backend: C#, .NET APIs and services.
  • Frontend: React (TypeScript-based UI).
  • Database: Microsoft SQL Server.
  • Cloud & Infrastructure: Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services (AWS).
  • The AI Tech Lead will work within this environment while introducing and integrating modern AI technologies such as large language model APIs, AI agents, vector databases, and AI orchestration frameworks as part of FreightPOP’s evolving platform architecture.


Skills & Expertise:

  • Passion for leveraging AI tools and emerging technologies.
  • Strong understanding of modern AI ecosystems (LLMs, MCPs, agents, embeddings, vector databases).
  • Experience building AI-powered software systems or integrating AI capabilities into applications.
  • Experience designing scalable SaaS architectures and distributed systems.
  • Ability to rapidly prototype and iterate AI solutions.
  • Strong problem-solving and technical decision-making skills.
  • Experience in evaluating and adopting new technologies.
  • Strong oral and written communication skills.
  • Ability to collaborate across product, engineering, and leadership teams, including in distributed team environments.


Other Abilities:

  • Strong curiosity and passion for AI innovation.
  • Ability to work effectively in fast-paced and evolving technical environments.
  • Self-driven problem solver capable of working with ambiguity and rapidly evolving requirements.
  • Commitment to continuous learning and staying current with emerging technologies.

description:

***Please send your CV in English


About Foretellix:

Foretellix is the gold standard for data-driven autonomy development toolchains. Foretellix’s Foretify™ toolchain enables a measurable, efficient, and trusted path to safe and scalable autonomy that helps you launch with confidence. Building on its industry leading V&V technology, Foretellix is enabling the AI autonomy revolution.


Role Description:

Be part of the Application Engineering Team responsible for adapting and deploying Foretellix verification & validation solutions to our customers and making them successful at their mission to provide next-gen ADAS/AV products. Our Application Engineers have a unique mix of ADAS/AV domain knowledge, software expertise, creativity, and the ability to work closely with customers to maximize the impact our solution can have on their ability to deliver high quality, safe products.


What will you do:

  • Deploy the Foretellix solution at customer accounts. From tools installation and integration, customer training and ramp-up, to defining the V&V strategy, including both remote and on-site support.
  • Shape our products by being the primary point of contact between the customer and R&D. Understand the customer’s V&V challenges and translate them into product requirements to help improve the products.
  • Work with the sales team as the technical product expert to develop and deliver demos and presentations to customers, as well as guide and support customer product evaluations.
  • When required, create application notes, methodology documents, technical presentations and customer trainings.


Requirements:

  • At least 3 years of industry working experience, ideally in the ADAS/AV domain.
  • Knowledge in Software Engineering, including OO programming, testing, and debugging.
  • BSc or above in the areas of Computer Science, Automotive Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, or other related fields.
  • Have excellent human relationship skills
  • Be communicative and fluent in English, both verbal and in writing.
  • Be a team-player, resourceful, and professional.


Advantages:

  • Experience in ADAS/AV V&V, testing, and simulation.
  • Previous experience in customer facing engineering such as Field Application Engineering, Sales Engineering, Professional Services, or related positions.
  • Running and working with ADAS/AV Simulators, e.g. Carla, Sumo, Carmaker, Vires, etc...
  • Employee in one of the ADAS/AV companies, or one of the companies serving them.
  • Previous experience as a Product Manager / Methodology Engineer.
  • Knowledge & experience with ADAS/AV verification.
  • Knowledge & experience with advanced verification, and specifically with Specman and the ‘e’ language, and/or SystemVerilog UVM, Perspec PSS, and Coverage Driven Verification.
  • MSc or above in the areas of Computer Science, Automotive Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, or other related fields.
  • Substantial experience in Software Engineering, including OO programming.

Procuramos profissionais que já atuam no mercado e sabem gerar resultados.

A WFLEX/BR AMBIENTAL está em expansão e busca Representantes Comerciais com experiência comprovada no setor de óleos lubrificantes, graxas, fluidos industriais e produtos correlatos.

Nosso objetivo não é formar vendedores iniciantes. Procuramos profissionais que já possuam conhecimento técnico-comercial do segmento, relacionamento com clientes e capacidade de desenvolver negócios de forma consultiva e estratégica.

  • Experiência na venda de óleos lubrificantes, graxas, fluidos industriais ou segmentos correlatos;
  • Carteira ativa de clientes será considerada um diferencial relevante;
  • Conhecimento dos canais de distribuição, indústrias, transportadoras, oficinas, frotistas, agroindústrias ou revendas;
  • Perfil empreendedor, com autonomia para prospecção e desenvolvimento de mercado;
  • Excelente capacidade de negociação e relacionamento comercial;
  • Disponibilidade para visitas presenciais e expansão da base de clientes.

O que oferecemos:

  • Portfólio competitivo e em constante evolução;
  • Estrutura comercial para suporte às negociações;
  • Agilidade nos processos comerciais e atendimento ao cliente;
  • Comissionamento atrativo e sem limite de ganhos;
  • Possibilidade de crescimento junto a uma empresa em expansão nacional;
  • Ambiente profissional focado em resultados, meritocracia e desenvolvimento de mercado.

Diferenciais que buscamos:

  • Carteira consolidada no segmento de lubrificantes;
  • Experiência com vendas técnicas para indústria, transporte, mineração, agronegócio ou mercado automotivo;
  • Histórico comprovado de crescimento de faturamento e abertura de novos mercados.

Se você é um profissional que construiu credibilidade no mercado, possui relacionamentos sólidos e busca representar uma empresa que valoriza performance, ética e visão de longo prazo, queremos conversar com você.

Não buscamos apenas vendedores. Procuramos parceiros comerciais capazes de construir mercados, desenvolver clientes e crescer junto com a empresa.


Envie seu currículo e uma breve apresentação profissional informando sua região de atuação e experiência no segmento.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor full stack em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Service Engineer - Full stack - Agular & .NET - Job Summary

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Full Stack Developer with deep expertise in Angular and .NET to join our engineering team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and delivering scalable, secure, and high-performance web applications across the full technology stack. You will play a key role in system architecture, lead technical initiatives, and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to build modern, enterprise-grade solutions. This is an excellent opportunity for a senior engineer who is passionate about clean code, modern frameworks, and delivering impactful digital products.

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain full stack applications using Angular (frontend) and .NET (backend)

Lead system architecture and contribute to design decisions for scalable and maintainable systems

Develop responsive, user-friendly UI components and integrate them with backend services

Build and maintain RESTful APIs and microservices using .NET technologies

Collaborate with product managers, designers, QA engineers, and other stakeholders

Optimize application performance, security, and scalability

Perform code reviews and ensure adherence to best practices and coding standards

Mentor and guide junior and mid-level developers

Participate in Agile/Scrum processes and contribute to continuous improvement

Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues across the application stack

Required Qualifications and Experience

10+ years of professional software development experience

Strong expertise in Angular (preferably Angular 10+) and TypeScript

Extensive experience with .NET technologies (C#, .NET Core / .NET 6+)

Solid understanding of web architecture, RESTful services, and API design

Experience developing and maintaining microservices-based architectures

Strong knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, and responsive design principles

Proficiency with relational databases (e.g., SQL Server, PostgreSQL) and/or NoSQL databases

Experience with version control systems such as Git

Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices

Strong understanding of design patterns and software engineering principles

Preferred Skills and Technologies

Experience with Azure (App Services, Functions, DevOps, etc.) or other cloud platforms (AWS, GCP)

Knowledge of containerization and orchestration tools (Docker, Kubernetes)

Familiarity with frontend libraries and UI frameworks (Angular Material, Bootstrap, Tailwind)

Experience with state management solutions (NgRx, Akita)

title: Frontend Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Frontend Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who We Are:

DEXIAN is a global American consulting company focused on technology talent solutions to support and strengthen our clients’ IT teams. We are present in 10 countries, with 45 offices worldwide. For more than 25 years, DEXIAN® has been serving global clients across multiple industries, with the mission of attracting and retaining the world’s top talent.

Today, we are proudly recognized as one of the largest staffing augmentation companies in the United States by Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA). We are also a Minority-Owned Company, and we take pride in our strong commitment to diversity.

In Brazil, we have been operating since 2007 and have successfully partnered with more than 50 clients from different sectors of the economy.


What to Expect From Us:

At DEXIAN, every movement is guided by five core values: collaboration, respect, fairness, commitment, and ingenuity. These are not just concepts — they define how we work, build partnerships, and support our teams every day.

If you share these values, this is the right place for you to grow your career.

DEXIAN Brazil strongly encourages diversity, and all opportunities are open to people with disabilities and rehabilitated professionals.


Responsibilities:

Front-end Architecture & Engineering Excellence

Develop and maintain scalable, secure, and performant frontend architectures using React and Next.js.

Drive UI componentization, micro-frontend strategies, and maintainable design patterns.

Implement best practices for internationalization (i18n) and localization (l10n) strategies.

Define modular, reusable, and optimized frontend patterns, including caching, lazy loading, and API consumption strategies.

Ensure adherence to Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) and contribute to org-wide documentation.

Front-end Policies and Standards & Tooling

Establish and enforce best practices for CI/CD workflows, environment configurations, and feedback loops.

Optimize frontend tooling, framework selection, and quality gating processes.

Maintain high standards for code quality, security, and performance compliance.

Website Operations & Performance Optimization

Drive disaster recovery and resiliency planning for frontend applications.

Implement logging strategies for efficient debugging and minimal Mean Time to Resolution (MTTR).

Define and maintain monitoring, alerting, and on-call strategies for frontend issues.

Optimize frontend performance (TTI, FCP, page speed, etc.) and ensure continuous tracking through dashboards and metrics.

Collaboration & Evangelism

Work closely with backend, DevOps, and product teams to drive best-in-class frontend solutions.

Advocate for frontend engineering needs across the organization, collaborating with Principal Engineers and stakeholders.

Lead knowledge-sharing sessions, mentorship programs, and training initiatives to upskill teams in frontend development.

Stay updated on industry trends and emerging frontend technologies to continuously improve the tech stack.


Skills:

Strong experience in eCommerce frontend architecture and best practices.

Exposure to major eCommerce platforms like SAP Commerce Cloud, Magento, Mirakl, Salesforce Commerce Cloud.

Understanding of headless commerce, PWA strategies, and API-driven eCommerce architectures.

Expert-level proficiency in JavaScript, TypeScript, React.js, Next.js.

Deep knowledge of frontend build systems & bundlers (Webpack, Vite, esbuild, Turbopack).

Strong expertise in CSS frameworks (TailwindCSS, Bootstrap, Styled Components, Emotion).

Experience designing scalable component-based architectures.

Proficiency in module federation and federated design systems.

Strong understanding of API consumption strategies (REST, GraphQL, gRPC, WebSockets, Server-Sent Events).

Deep expertise in frontend performance optimization (TTI, FCP, LCP, CLS).

Strong knowledge of caching strategies (client/server/edge caching, CDNs).

Experience in server-side rendering (SSR), static site generation (SSG), and ISR in Next.js.

Advocate of strong quality controls, including:

Unit Testing (Jest, Mocha, Vitest).

Integration & E2E Testing (Playwright, Webdriver.io, Cypress).

Performance & Accessibility Testing (Lighthouse, WebPageTest, Axe-core).

Experience with one or more major cloud platforms (Azure preferred, AWS, Google Cloud).

Understanding of Containerization (Docker, Kubernetes, K3S, EKS, AKS, GKE).

Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines with automated testing for frontend applications.

Strong communication and presentation skills

Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent.

5+ years of industry experience, with a focus on frontend development

Hr Path Group

O Grupo HR Path, um interveniente global na consultoria de RH, acompanha os seus clientes nos seus projetos de transformação de RH, tanto nos aspectos humanos como nas ferramentas (HRIS). Intervimos na Europa, América e Ásia-Pacífico, para as nossas grandes contas e clientes PME, a fim de lhes oferecer um apoio global no desenvolvimento da sua estratégia de RH.

Aconselhar para executar! HR Path, líder mundial em soluções de RH

  • Advise: Acompanhamos os nossos clientes na transformação da sua função de RH, através de uma redefinição da sua organização de RH e da digitalização do seu HRIS
  • Implement: Como parceiro dos principais editores do mercado, realizamos projetos de implementação técnica e funcional de todas as soluções HRIS (SaaS ou On-Premise)
  • Run: Graças à nossa experiência global em processamento de salários, oferecemos aos nossos clientes vários níveis de externalização de salários.


O que estamos buscando:

Profissional fará parte do time de consultores funcionais de projetos do Sistema SAP ECP para Folha de Pagamento. Deverá executar atividades conforme melhores práticas de mercado seguindo nossa metodologia de implementação.


Atividades a serem desenvolvidas:

Atuar em projetos de implementação do ECP com foco em Folha de Pagamento;

Elaborar documentações necessárias de cada atividade de acordo com padrão estabelecido por cada cliente;

Ministrar treinamento para usuários;

Treinar e capacitar pessoas da equipe/clientes nos módulos do SAP ECP;

Colaborar com equipes internas e fornecedores para implementar as soluções propostas;

Manter-se atualizado com as últimas liberações e produtos da SAP que envolvem os módulos do SAP /ECP.


Requisitos:

  • Formação superior em Administração, RH, Sistemas ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência de no mínimo 12 anos nos módulos do SAP HCM/ECP com atuação em projetos;
  • Atuação como consultor responsável/líder da frente em pelo menos 1 projeto de medio a grande porte;
  • Conhecimento em eSocial, desejável;
  • Certificação SAP nos módulos relevantes, caso não tenha será necessário se certificar para iniciar nos projetos;
  • Conhecimento Funcional na Integração entre os sistemas EC x ECP e/ou EC x HCM;
  • Conhecimento em Folha de Pagamentos de outros países será um diferencial.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business Specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.


1, Document Preparation and Analysis (Pre-Shipment): This phase focuses on ensuring all documentation is correct before shipment. It includes receiving and checking the Purchase Order (PO), the fiscal classification (NCM) of the goods, analyzing draft documents (CI, PL, BL drafts), and initial registration in the system.



2, Shipment Management and Customs Procedures: This stage covers the active management of the process while the cargo is in transit. It involves obtaining the Import License (LI), collecting original documents, validating the Bill of Lading (BL), and continuous coordination with the customs broker and the bonded terminal


.
3, Clearance Monitoring and Closing (Post-Arrival): This phase begins upon cargo arrival. It includes full door-to-door logistics follow-up, cargo presence confirmation, monitoring customs clearance (DI/DUIMP), coordinating domestic transport, and finally, archiving all documents to close the proces


s.
4, Invoice Auditing and Cost Validation: This phase focuses on verifying the accuracy of all operational costs before payment. It includes receiving and cross-referencing invoices (from freight forwarders, carriers, terminals, customs brokers) against negotiated tariffs, operational records, and system data (e.g., demurrage/detention days, storage fees) to identify and dispute discrepanci


es.
5, Payment Processing and Budget Allocation: This stage covers the financial execution and control. It involves launching approved invoices into the financial system (ERP), correctly allocating all costs to the specific import process or cost center, scheduling payments according to financial policy, and serving as the main point of contact for supplier payment inquir


ies.
6, Cost Analysis and Performance Reporting: This final phase focuses on data analysis and strategic support. It includes compiling financial data, generating periodic reports (e.g., total logistics cost, cost-per-container, variance analysis against budget), and providing data-driven insights to support new supplier negotiations and identify cost-saving opportuni

ties.

title: Talent Acquisition Partner
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Talent Acquisition Partner em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Talent Acquisition Partner (Active Sourcing)


Location: Fully Remote (Must be based in LATAM)

Job Type: Full-Time



About Uproot Clean

Uproot Clean is a fast-growing consumer products company with more than 5 million customers using our products. Our products are sold not only through DTC and Amazon, but also through major retailers, including Walmart, Target, and Petco, along with more than 10,000 retail doors across the country. Uproot has also been featured across major television and media platforms, including QVC, Good Morning America, and Fox, helping introduce millions of consumers to the brand.

We care deeply about building products that genuinely solve problems for pet owners while operating with high standards across every part of the business. We are building a company focused on long-term excellence, creating significant opportunities for highly capable people who want real and meaningful impact, and the ability to help shape the future of the company.

About the Role

This is a hands-on execution role focused 100% on active sourcing. You will proactively identify and engage high-quality talent across multiple functions and seniority levels using multiple sourcing channels, advanced search techniques, and thoughtful outreach.

Success requires high-output execution, strong judgment, persistence, excellent communication, and the ability to operate with urgency in a fast-moving environment.



Responsibilities


Active Sourcing

  • Proactively source candidates across multiple job boards, platforms, and sourcing channels
  • Use advanced Boolean search techniques to identify strong talent
  • Build pipelines across multiple functions and seniority levels
  • Identify strong passive candidates
  • Partner closely with recruiting and hiring managers to align on hiring needs.

Candidate Outreach

  • Write outbound messaging that drives candidate engagement
  • Qualify candidates early in the process
  • Move qualified candidates into the recruiting workflow

Pipeline Management

  • Maintain organized sourcing workflows and candidate tracking
  • Continuously improve sourcing strategies and outreach quality
  • Continuously iterate on sourcing methods, messaging, and targeting

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistently builds high-quality candidate pipelines
  • Surfaces strong candidates quickly across multiple functions
  • Generates strong response and assessment completion rates
  • Operates with speed, consistency, and minimal oversight
  • Raises the overall talent bar of the company over time


Requirements

Must Have

  • 1+ year of full-time active sourcing experience - mandatory
  • Experience sourcing across multiple job boards and sourcing platforms
  • Strong outbound recruiting and candidate outreach skills
  • Experience using advanced Boolean search techniques
  • Excellent written English communication skills
  • Ability to manage multiple open searches simultaneously

Strong Plus

  • Experience sourcing across multiple functions and seniority levels
  • Experience in high-growth, e-commerce, or performance-driven companies
  • Familiarity with LinkedIn Recruiter and modern sourcing tools

Work Requirements

⏰ Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST

Workspace: Fixed, professional setup (no digital nomads)

Output: Daily briefs and feedback loops (high consistency required)


Who This Role Is For (& Not For)

This Role Is For You If:

  • You enjoy the challenge of finding exceptional people before anyone else does
  • You are naturally proactive and internally driven
  • You move quickly, stay organized, and maintain high standards
  • You enjoy performance-oriented environments with accountability
  • You think recruiting is a high-leverage business function, not administrative work
  • You enjoy improving systems, processes, and sourcing quality over time

This Role Is NOT For You If:

  • You need constant direction or external motivation
  • You struggle with consistency and follow-through
  • You are uncomfortable persuading passive candidates
  • You treat recruiting as scheduling and coordination only


Compensation & Benefits

Uproot Clean is a high ownership, high accountability environment with high standards for communication, speed, execution, and quality. We care far more about ability, judgment, and ownership than credentials or years of experience.

  • Salary : Competitive base salary + performance-based bonus structure
  • Significant autonomy with the ability to directly influence the company’s growth and direction
  • Fully remote : work from anywhere
  • PTO : 2 Weeks
  • Flex Day : An additional quarterly day off dedicated to rest and recovery
  • Thinking Day: one dedicated day each quarter to step away from day-to-day execution and think deeply about your role, systems, ideas, and long-term impact
  • Wellness Reimbursement: $100-$300/month, based on location, to help support your wellness.
  • Pet Reimbursement: $40-100/month, based on location to help support parenting a pet.
  • Coaching credits: $1,000+/year for coaching, education, and professional development


Ready to Apply?

If you are excited by high standards, proactive recruiting, and the challenge of building world-class talent pipelines, we’d love to hear from you.

WHO ARE WE?


We are a bunch of super enthusiastic, passionate, and highly driven people, working to achieve a common goal! We believe that work and the workplace should be joyful and always buzzing with energy!


CloudSEK, one of India’s most trusted Cyber security product companies, is on a mission to build the world’s fastest and most reliable AI technology that identifies and resolves digital threats in real-time. The central proposition is leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to create a quick and reliable analysis and alert system that provides rapid detection across multiple internet sources, precise threat analysis, and prompt resolution with minimal human intervention.


Founded in 2015, headquartered at Singapore, we are proud to say that we’ve grown at a frenetic pace and have been able to achieve some accolades along the way, including:


CloudSEK’s Product Suite:


CloudSEK XVigil constantly maps a customer’s digital assets, identifies threats and enriches them with cyber intelligence, and then provides workflows to manage and remediate all identified threats including takedown support.

A powerful Attack Surface Monitoring tool that gives visibility and intelligence on customers’ attack surfaces. CloudSEK's BeVigil uses a combination of Mobile, Web, Network and Encryption Scanners to map and protect known and unknown assets.

CloudSEK’s Contextual AI SVigil identifies software supply chain risks by monitoring Software, Cloud Services, and third-party dependencies.

Key Milestones:


  • 2016: Launched our first product.
  • 2018: Secured Pre-series A funding.
  • 2019: Expanded operations to India, Southeast Asia, and the Americas.
  • 2020: Won the NASSCOM-DSCI Excellence Award for Security Product Company of the Year.
  • 2021: Raised $7M in Series A funding led by MassMutual Ventures.
  • Awards & Recognition: Won NetApp Excellerator's \"Best Growth Strategy Award,\" CloudSEK XVigil joined NVIDIA Inception Program, and won the NASSCOM Emerge 50 Cybersecurity Award.
  • 2025: Secured $19 million in funding led by Tenacity Ventures, Commvault.


Job Description:

As a Customer Success Manager at CloudSEK , you will be the primary point of contact for a few strategic accounts, ensuring they derive maximum value from our cybersecurity solutions . Your role will involve deep engagement with clients , providing expert guidance on threat management, and ensuring seamless integration and utilization of CloudSEK’s products . Your background in cybersecurity will be crucial in understanding and addressing the specific needs and challenges faced by our clients.


Key Responsibilities:


Account Management:

  • Manage and nurture relationships for a client accounts, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and retention.
  • Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and Annual Business Reviews (ABRs) to assess and enhance customer engagement.
  • Visit customers twice a year to strengthen relationships and understand their evolving needs.

Cybersecurity Expertise:

  • Provide expert guidance on threat intelligence, data leak prevention, and other cybersecurity issues.
  • Act as a security analyst, offering insights and recommendations based on threats generated by CloudSEK’s platform.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack Sênior (Plataforma de RH e DP)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack Sênior (Plataforma de RH e DP) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack Sênior para ser um pilar técnico no desenvolvimento e evolução dos nossos produtos corporativos, com foco principal na criação da nossa nova plataforma interna de Recursos Humanos e Departamento Pessoal. Em um ambiente dinâmico de uma empresa de gestão de saúde, sua missão é atuar de ponta a ponta na construção de soluções de alto impacto.


Você liderará tecnicamente o desenvolvimento de um ecossistema completo que gerenciará a jornada dos nossos colaboradores, desde a admissão virtual e gestão de ponto eletrônico, até o processamento complexo da folha de pagamento. Além de escrever código escalável e de alta qualidade utilizando o ecossistema Node.js e React, você deverá liderar pelo exemplo, mentorar outros desenvolvedores e ditar os padrões de arquitetura da equipe.



Principais Responsabilidades


  • Arquitetura e Desenvolvimento: Projetar e desenvolver aplicações full stack de alta complexidade, implementando padrões de arquitetura definidos e garantindo a consistência do código.
  • Desenvolvimento de Módulos Core (RH/DP):
  • Criar fluxos de Admissão automatizados e seguros.
  • Construir e manter o motor de cálculo da Folha de Pagamento e Rescisões, garantindo precisão absoluta.
  • Desenvolver a gestão de Férias e o processamento de marcações de Ponto Eletrônico.
  • Legislação e Integrações: Traduzir regras da CLT e acordos sindicais em lógicas de sistema. Criar integrações robustas com sistemas bancários, APIs contábeis e órgãos governamentais (ex: e-Social), além de atuar no design de APIs (REST).
  • Liderança e Mentoria: Mentorar desenvolvedores(as) de nível pleno e júnior, realizando code reviews construtivos e disseminando boas práticas de mercado.
  • Automação e Qualidade: Garantir a qualidade através da implementação de uma estratégia sólida de testes automatizados (unitários, integração, e2e) e utilizar ativamente ferramentas de IA para geração de código, visando produtividade.
  • Infraestrutura e Deploy: Trabalhar com Docker para manter ambientes consistentes e atuar ativamente em esteiras de CI/CD para entregas contínuas.



Formação e Experiência


  • Experiência Específica em RH: Experiência comprovada na construção de sistemas de Recursos Humanos (HCM/HRMS), Departamento Pessoal, Workforce Management (ponto/escalas) ou plataformas de processamento financeiro complexo.
  • Experiência Técnica: Sólida vivência em desenvolvimento full stack corporativo, atuando de ponta a ponta na concepção de produtos.
  • Metodologias: Sólida vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) em times de produto, além de entendimento claro de workflows como GitFlow.
  • Formação: Ensino Superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou experiência prática equivalente.



Habilidades Técnicas (Hard Skills)


  • Stack Principal: Domínio avançado do ecossistema Node.js (NestJS, Express) e React (incluindo Next.js). Familiaridade com TypeScript e Vue.js.
  • Bancos de Dados: Proficiência em bancos relacionais (PostgreSQL, MySQL), ORMs, modelagem de tabelas e entendimento profundo de DER, além de transações consistentes.
  • DevOps & Cloud: Excelente conhecimento em Docker e ambiente Linux. Vivência prática com provedores Cloud (GCP, Azure) e cultura DevOps (CI/CD).
  • Ferramentas: Proficiência com Git/GitHub e experiência no uso de ferramentas de IA assistiva (como Claude Code ou similares).



Habilidades Comportamentais (Soft Skills)


  • Autonomia e Pragmatismo: Capacidade de resolver problemas complexos com autonomia, propondo melhorias técnicas e transitando entre tecnologias de forma pragmática, focando na melhor solução para o contexto.
  • Foco no Usuário e Qualidade: Entender a criticidade financeira e humana de um sistema de DP/RH, responsabilizando-se pelo funcionamento impecável das regras de negócio.
  • Tradução de Requisitos: Facilidade para dialogar com especialistas de DP/RH para transformar leis e portarias em lógica matemática de software.
  • Gestão de Crise: Perfil analítico para lidar com gargalos ou bugs de forma ágil e fria, especialmente em momentos críticos (fechamento de folha).



Diferenciais


  • Experiência com React Native para desenvolvimento mobile.
  • Conhecimentos avançados em performance de aplicações e otimização de queries de banco de dados.
  • Conhecimento prévio em PHP e/ou Python para auxiliar na manutenção ou migração de sistemas legados.
  • Ter atuado em HRTechs ou possuir forte interesse no desenvolvimento de produtos para a área da saúde.



Contrato PJ

100% Remoto


E aí, topa o desafio?


Estamos ansiosos para ter você conosco! ☺

Job Type: Full-Time

Customer experience is at the core of our brand. Every interaction matters, and how we show up for our customers directly impacts retention, trust, and growth.

  • Ownership & autonomy - trusted to build and execute strategy
  • Professional development - opportunities to learn and grow with the business

If you care about delivering great customer experiences and want to be part of a fast-moving team, apply now.
