title: AI Quality Analyst (Portgugal Portuguese )
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Quality Analyst (Portgugal Portuguese ) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Description:

MillionLogics is a trusted Oracle Partner and global leader in IT solutions, with operations in London, UK, and a development hub in Hyderabad, India. Specialising in innovative and scalable services, MillionLogics empowers enterprises through data & AI, cloud solutions, IT consulting, and custom application development. With a team of 85+ AI/ML experts, we deliver tailored solutions that foster digital transformation and operational excellence. We are committed to client success. We blend world-class technical expertise with strategic insight to deliver results.


Role Overview:

As an AI quality analyst, you will evaluate a new personalisation feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigour. You will actively design prompts from your personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalised responses, evaluating dimensions such as grounding, integration, and helpfulness.


Offer Details:

  • Duration of Contract : 12 months
  • Pay: $1500 per month (net/take-home)
  • Mode of work: Fully Remote
  • Number of Positions: 20
  • Must have fluency in Portugal Portuguese (not Brazilian Portuguese)



Key Qualifications:

  • Portuguese Proficiency : Ability to read and write in Portugal Portuguese (not Brazilian Portuguese) with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project.
  • Personal Account Usage: Willing to use computer science, primary personal Google account (not a testing account), and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate the ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalisation quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalisation concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalisation, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and over-narrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalised AI interactions. Your day-to-day work will involve:
  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilise your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalisation was appropriately applied.
  • Analysing responses for grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"over-narrating\".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilised.
  • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.



Education & Experience:

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., policy, law, ethics, linguistics, journalism, computer science, or a related analytical field).
  • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.


Additional Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week, with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor
  • Engagement Length: 12 months

title: Head of Liquidity LATAM
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Head of Liquidity LATAM em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Company

We are a leading digital asset platform that provides trading, brokerage, custody, and infrastructure solutions for institutional and professional investors. As the business continues to grow, they are seeking an experienced liquidity professional to lead and enhance their global liquidity capabilities.


Role Overview

This leadership role is responsible for overseeing liquidity strategy across digital asset and FX markets in LATAM, ensuring efficient market access, strong execution quality, and robust liquidity coverage across trading products. The successful candidate will work closely with Trading, Sales, Product, Risk, Compliance, Treasury, and Technology teams to support the firm's institutional trading business. We cover stablecoins, on/off ramp and cross-border payments as well. Candidates with relevant experiences will be prioritized.


Key Responsibilities

Liquidity Management

  • Develop and execute the firm's liquidity strategy across digital asset and FX-related markets.
  • Source, onboard, and manage relationships with liquidity providers, market makers, brokers, exchanges, and banking partners.
  • Monitor liquidity quality, market depth, pricing competitiveness, and venue performance.
  • Ensure sufficient liquidity coverage across supported products and trading activities.


FX & Trading Operations

  • Oversee liquidity and execution across FX and digital asset trading flows.
  • Monitor market developments and identify opportunities to improve execution performance and pricing.
  • Analyze trading activity, transaction costs, spreads, and execution metrics.
  • Partner with trading and treasury teams to optimize execution workflows and market access.


Counterparty & Vendor Management

  • Build and maintain relationships with key liquidity providers and institutional counterparties.
  • Support commercial negotiations, fee discussions, and service-level reviews.
  • Conduct ongoing assessments and due diligence of trading venues and liquidity partners.


Risk & Governance

  • Work closely with Risk and Compliance teams to ensure appropriate controls and oversight.
  • Monitor counterparty, settlement, and liquidity-related risks.
  • Support contingency planning and business continuity measures during periods of market stress.


Leadership & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Lead and develop the liquidity function.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders across Trading, Treasury, Product, Technology, Risk, and Compliance teams.
  • Provide management reporting on liquidity performance, market developments, and strategic initiatives.


Requirements

  • Significant experience in liquidity management, electronic trading, FX trading, market structure, market making, brokerage, or institutional trading environments.
  • Experience sourcing, evaluating, and managing relationships with liquidity providers, brokers, market makers, exchanges, and banking partners.
  • Strong understanding of FX and/or digital asset liquidity ecosystems and execution practices.
  • Ability to analyze execution quality, transaction costs, and liquidity performance metrics.
  • Commercially minded with strong negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience working within regulated financial services environments.
  • Excellent communication, leadership, and relationship management capabilities.

title: Gerente de FP&A e Controladoria Global
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Gerente de FP&A e Controladoria Global em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

O Grupo Nuveto está em busca de um(a) Gerente Global de FP&A e Controladoria para liderar a governança financeira, a consolidação contábil e o planejamento financeiro das operações do grupo em múltiplos países. Essa posição terá como missão garantir a confiabilidade e a conformidade das informações financeiras, fortalecer os controles e processos corporativos, além de transformar dados financeiros e operacionais em análises estratégicas que apoiem a tomada de decisão da liderança, impulsionando o crescimento sustentável, a rentabilidade e a escalabilidade do negócio.



Responsabilidades

  • Fechamento Contábil;
  • Coordenar o processo de fechamento contábil mensal, trimestral e anual, garantindo cumprimento de prazos e qualidade das informações;
  • Supervisionar a conciliação de contas e a consistência dos lançamentos contábeis entre as unidades do grupo;
  • Gerenciar o processo de consolidação das demonstrações financeiras das entidades multipaíses, incluindo eliminações intercompany;
  • Assegurar a correta apuração de resultados por unidade de negócio e por país, suportando a visão segmentada da liderança;
  • Ser o ponto de contato principal com auditores externos, coordenando a entrega de informações e suporte às auditorias. Conformidade e Políticas Internas;
  • Garantir a aderência das operações financeiras às políticas internas do grupo, normas contábeis (CPC/IFRS) e requisitos regulatórios de cada país;
  • Desenvolver, documentar e revisar políticas e procedimentos de controladoria, promovendo padronização entre as unidades;
  • Monitorar controles internos financeiros, identificando gaps e implementando melhorias para mitigar riscos operacionais;
  • Suportar processos de due diligence e revisões internas, garantindo a integridade e rastreabilidade das informações financeiras;
  • Assegurar que os processos de aprovação, alçadas e segregação de funções estejam implementados e operacionais. Relatórios Gerenciais e FP&A;
  • Elaborar e evoluir continuamente o pacote de relatórios gerenciais mensais (management report) para o CFO, CEO e board;
  • Construir análises de variância entre realizado e orçado (actual vs. budget / forecast), identificando desvios e propondo planos de ação em conjunto com as áreas de negócio;
  • Apoiar o processo de orçamento anual (budget) e revisões de forecast, garantindo a consistência entre as premissas contábeis e financeiras;
  • Desenvolver dashboards e indicadores financeiros relevantes para o modelo SaaS: MRR, ARR, Churn, CAC, LTV e Rule of 40;
  • Traduzir dados contábeis em insights acionáveis para a liderança, conectando a visão financeira à estratégia do negócio.


Qualificações

  • Graduação em Ciências Contábeis, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência sólida em controladoria com foco em fechamento contábil, relatórios gerenciais e conformidade;
  • Vivência com operações em múltiplos países e consolidação de demonstrações financeiras intercompany;
  • Domínio do ERP TOTVS (Protheus ou Datasul), especialmente nos módulos Contábil e Financeiro;
  • Conhecimento de normas contábeis brasileiras (CPC/IFRS) e experiência com consolidação de demonstrações financeiras;
  • Experiência na elaboração de relatórios gerenciais e análises de variância (budget vs. actual);
  • Inglês intermediário / avançado para comunicação com entidades internacionais


O que esperamos de você:


  • Capacidade de atuar de forma colaborativa, construindo relacionamentos de confiança e promovendo a integração entre diferentes áreas e países.
  • Forte visão analítica para interpretar dados financeiros e operacionais, identificar tendências, antecipar riscos e apoiar decisões estratégicas.
  • Perfil de liderança, com habilidade para influenciar stakeholders, conduzir projetos complexos;
  • Proatividade para identificar oportunidades de melhoria, simplificar processos e fortalecer a governança financeira da organização;
  • Comunicação clara e objetiva, sendo capaz de traduzir informações financeiras complexas em insights relevantes para diferentes públicos;
  • Orientação para resultados, conciliando excelência técnica, visão de negócio e foco na geração de valor para a companhia;


Diferenciais que somam pontos:

  • Conhecimento de estruturação de dados e governança


Benefícios

  • Vale Refeição (Flash Benefícios);
  • Recesso
  • Day Off no aniversário;
  • Total Pass;
  • Convênio Médico e Odontológico;


Modelo: Pessoa Jurídica

Jornada: Segunda a sexta

Salário: A combinar


Nossa Cultura:

Crescemos com base em quatro pilares: Foco em Resultados, Compromisso com o Cliente, Inovação Contínua e Relacionamentos Transparentes.

Aqui, você encontra um ambiente dinâmico, colaborativo e inovador, onde ideias ganham espaço e cada pessoa tem a oportunidade de fazer a diferença.

Venha fazer parte desse time!

title: AI Quality Analyst (Portgugal Portuguese )
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Quality Analyst (Portgugal Portuguese ) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Description:

MillionLogics is a trusted Oracle Partner and global leader in IT solutions, with operations in London, UK, and a development hub in Hyderabad, India. Specialising in innovative and scalable services, MillionLogics empowers enterprises through data & AI, cloud solutions, IT consulting, and custom application development. With a team of 85+ AI/ML experts, we deliver tailored solutions that foster digital transformation and operational excellence. We are committed to client success. We blend world-class technical expertise with strategic insight to deliver results.


Role Overview:

As an AI quality analyst, you will evaluate a new personalisation feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigour. You will actively design prompts from your personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalised responses, evaluating dimensions such as grounding, integration, and helpfulness.


Offer Details:

  • Duration of Contract : 12 months
  • Pay: $1500 per month (net/take-home)
  • Mode of work: Fully Remote
  • Number of Positions: 20
  • Must have fluency in Portugal Portuguese (not Brazilian Portuguese)



Key Qualifications:

  • Portuguese Proficiency : Ability to read and write in Portugal Portuguese (not Brazilian Portuguese) with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project.
  • Personal Account Usage: Willing to use computer science, primary personal Google account (not a testing account), and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate the ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalisation quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalisation concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalisation, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and over-narrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalised AI interactions. Your day-to-day work will involve:
  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilise your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalisation was appropriately applied.
  • Analysing responses for grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"over-narrating\".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilised.
  • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.



Education & Experience:

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., policy, law, ethics, linguistics, journalism, computer science, or a related analytical field).
  • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.


Additional Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week, with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor
  • Engagement Length: 12 months

  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate the ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalisation quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalisation concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalisation, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and over-narrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalised AI interactions. Your day-to-day work will involve:
  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilise your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalisation was appropriately applied.
  • Analysing responses for grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"over-narrating\".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilised.
  • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.



Education & Experience:

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., policy, law, ethics, linguistics, journalism, computer science, or a related analytical field).
  • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.


Additional Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week, with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor
  • Engagement Length: 12 months

description:

Aqui na ília nossas vagas estão sempre abertas para todas as pessoas e não se restringem quanto a gênero, etnia, orientação sexual, fatores sociais, condições físicas ou intelectuais (PCD) etc. Incentivamos a candidatura de integrantes de todos os grupos minoritários!


Sobre a ília

Somos especialistas em tecnologia, dados e design, impulsionando a transformação digital de grandes players do mercado há mais de 10 anos, nos setores financeiro, seguros e mobilidade. Com mais de 450 profissionais, estamos presentes no Brasil e Europa, atendendo aos mercados da América Latina, Europa e América do Norte, desenvolvendo produtos digitais de alta qualidade e com foco em resultados de negócios. Somos uma equipe inovadora, criativa e apaixonada por tecnologia.

Certificada pelo 7° ano consecutivo como Great Place to work aqui na ília acreditamos que pessoas mudam o mundo, e investimos nelas. Nossas awesome deliveries são feitas de pessoas para pessoas, afinal awesome people make awesome deliveries!

#Vempraília!


Sobre a vaga:

Buscamos uma pessoa DevOps Pleno para projetar, desenvolver e manter pipelines de CI/CD no Azure DevOps, garantindo processos automatizados e seguros de build, teste e entrega de software. A pessoa será responsável pela criação e manutenção de Dockerfiles e imagens de contêiner, pela construção de templates base para projetos em React e .NET, e pela gestão do Azure DevOps — com destaque para o Azure Boards —, promovendo padronização, qualidade, segurança e eficiência em todo o ciclo de desenvolvimento.


Responsabilidades:

  • Projetar, implementar e manter pipelines de CI/CD no Azure DevOps, automatizando build, teste, empacotamento e deploy com qualidade, rapidez e segurança.
  • Criar e manter Dockerfiles e imagens base, garantindo que estejam otimizadas, seguras e atualizadas, com scans de vulnerabilidades e aplicação de correções.
  • Integrar as imagens de contêiner aos pipelines de CI/CD, assegurando ambientes de execução consistentes e confiáveis.
  • Criar templates base para projetos React e .NET, com boas práticas de segurança, logs e automação desde o início, integrados a pipelines e repositórios padrão.
  • Gerenciar o Azure DevOps e o Azure Boards: criar e configurar projetos, times e áreas de trabalho, montar boards com colunas, sprints e workflows ágeis, e controlar permissões, templates e políticas.
  • Identificar e automatizar tarefas repetitivas, criando padrões reutilizáveis (YAML, scripts, templates) para todo o ciclo DevOps.
  • Documentar e divulgar boas práticas, fortalecendo a cultura de infraestrutura como código e entrega contínua.
  • Atuar como referência técnica para os times de desenvolvimento e operações, apoiando em problemas de build, deploy e pipelines, configuração de containers e ambientes, e uso de templates e do Azure Boards.
  • Garantir verificações de vulnerabilidades em imagens e pipelines, aplicar controles de acesso e segregação de permissões e integrar scans automatizados e auditorias ao ciclo de entrega.
  • Atuar de forma colaborativa com times de desenvolvimento, segurança e gestão de projetos, fomentando aprendizado contínuo e responsabilidade compartilhada.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência com Azure DevOps (Repos, Pipelines, Artifacts e Boards).
  • Criação e manutenção de pipelines CI/CD.
  • Gerenciamento do Azure Boards (criação de projetos, times, workflows, sprints e dashboards).
  • Criação e manutenção de Dockerfiles e imagens base.
  • Gestão de vulnerabilidades em containers e imagens.
  • Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform, Bicep, ARM).
  • Conhecimento em .NET e React.
  • Versionamento de código (Git).
  • Automação de builds e releases.
  • Monitoramento e integração de qualidade de código (SonarQube, CodeQL).
  • Sólida experiência em funções DevOps com foco em automação de pipelines, containers e integração contínua.
  • Formação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Sistemas, Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas correlatas.


Benefícios e Incentivos:

Nossa contratação é CLT- 40h semanais com jornada flexível, sendo executada de forma remota. Os benefícios da ília são pensados para proporcionar uma experiência AWESOME para cada ílian, abaixo você encontra os benefícios de forma resumida. #vempraília

A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). title: Customer Success Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Success Manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

WHO ARE WE?


We are a bunch of super enthusiastic, passionate, and highly driven people, working to achieve a common goal! We believe that work and the workplace should be joyful and always buzzing with energy!


CloudSEK, one of India’s most trusted Cyber security product companies, is on a mission to build the world’s fastest and most reliable AI technology that identifies and resolves digital threats in real-time. The central proposition is leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to create a quick and reliable analysis and alert system that provides rapid detection across multiple internet sources, precise threat analysis, and prompt resolution with minimal human intervention.


Founded in 2015, headquartered at Singapore, we are proud to say that we’ve grown at a frenetic pace and have been able to achieve some accolades along the way, including:


CloudSEK’s Product Suite:


CloudSEK XVigil constantly maps a customer’s digital assets, identifies threats and enriches them with cyber intelligence, and then provides workflows to manage and remediate all identified threats including takedown support.

A powerful Attack Surface Monitoring tool that gives visibility and intelligence on customers’ attack surfaces. CloudSEK's BeVigil uses a combination of Mobile, Web, Network and Encryption Scanners to map and protect known and unknown assets.

CloudSEK’s Contextual AI SVigil identifies software supply chain risks by monitoring Software, Cloud Services, and third-party dependencies.

Key Milestones:


  • 2016: Launched our first product.
  • 2018: Secured Pre-series A funding.
  • 2019: Expanded operations to India, Southeast Asia, and the Americas.
  • 2020: Won the NASSCOM-DSCI Excellence Award for Security Product Company of the Year.
  • 2021: Raised $7M in Series A funding led by MassMutual Ventures.
  • Awards & Recognition: Won NetApp Excellerator's \"Best Growth Strategy Award,\" CloudSEK XVigil joined NVIDIA Inception Program, and won the NASSCOM Emerge 50 Cybersecurity Award.
  • 2025: Secured $19 million in funding led by Tenacity Ventures, Commvault.


Job Description:

As a Customer Success Manager at CloudSEK , you will be the primary point of contact for a few strategic accounts, ensuring they derive maximum value from our cybersecurity solutions . Your role will involve deep engagement with clients , providing expert guidance on threat management, and ensuring seamless integration and utilization of CloudSEK’s products . Your background in cybersecurity will be crucial in understanding and addressing the specific needs and challenges faced by our clients.


Key Responsibilities:


Account Management:

  • Manage and nurture relationships for a client accounts, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and retention.
  • Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and Annual Business Reviews (ABRs) to assess and enhance customer engagement.
  • Visit customers twice a year to strengthen relationships and understand their evolving needs.

Cybersecurity Expertise:

  • Provide expert guidance on threat intelligence, data leak prevention, and other cybersecurity issues.
  • Act as a security analyst, offering insights and recommendations based on threats generated by CloudSEK’s platform.
  • Collaborate with customer security teams to ensure optimal usage of CloudSEK’s solutions.

Customer Engagement:

  • Develop and execute customer engagement strategies to build strong relationships with key stakeholders, including CXOs and CISOs.
  • Foster customer champions within client organizations to drive advocacy and referrals.
  • Generate and share client-specific quality reports, gathering feedback to continuously improve service delivery.

Revenue Generation and Retention:

  • Identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling CloudSEK’s products and services.
  • Ensure on-time renewals and maintain a high customer retention rate.
  • Source referrals and participate in revenue generation activities.

Product Usage and Feedback:

  • Ensure 100% product usage for features subscribed by the customers.
  • Conduct configuration reviews and provide recommendations for product enhancements.
  • Gather and analyze customer feedback to contribute to product development and improvement.

Operational Excellence:

  • Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and activities in CRM systems.
  • Contribute to the team by sharing knowledge, conducting training sessions, and writing internal articles.


Ideal candidate:

  • 4-5 years of experience in Cybersecurity & Client-facing experience, or a related role in the cybersecurity industry.
  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity principles, threat intelligence, and digital risk management.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships with clients. Strong language proficiency over English and Portuguese is required.
  • Proven track record of achieving customer success goals and driving revenue growth.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple accounts simultaneously.


Cookie points if you have experience in the below skills:

  • Business reviews:
  • Onsite meetings
  • Maintaining NRR and GRR
  • Threat analysis and Value delivery


Benefits of Joining CloudSEK:

We provide an environment where you can develop and enhance your skills while delivering meaningful work that matters. You’ll be rewarded a competitive salary as well as a full spectrum of generous perks and incentives which include:


Flexible working hours.

Food, unlimited snacks and drinks are all available while at office.

And, the finest part is yet to come! Every now and then we ensure to unwind and have a good time together, which involves games, fun, and soulful music. Feel free to show off your artistic side here!


CloudSEK is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

title: Video Editor
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Video Editor em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Creative Video Editor - DTC Brand


Location: Fully Remote (must be based in LATAM)

Job Type: Full-Time


Create scroll-stopping content for a scaling DTC brand. We need a performance-focused video editor who can turn raw footage into high-converting ads and social content - with creative freedom and direct feedback loops on what's working.


About Uproot Clean

Uproot Clean is a fast-growing, eco-friendly pet care brand expanding across major retailers like Walmart, Target, and Chewy. Our marketing team is scaling rapidly, and we're looking for a video editor who wants to grow their skills in performance marketing while building a long-term role with a mission-driven company.


The Role

You'll be our go-to editor for short-form video content that drives sales—think Facebook/Instagram ads, TikTok content, and social clips. You'll work with a steady flow of creator and product footage, turning it into thumb-stopping content that performs. This isn't agency churn-and-burn; you'll see what converts, iterate based on data, and refine your craft with real-time feedback.


What You'll Do

Video Editing & Production

  • Create high-performing Facebook/Instagram ad creatives and social media clips
  • Edit short-form content optimized for platform-specific formats
  • Source and organize B-roll and stock footage using the provided subscriptions
  • Manage creator content in Frame.io and maintain organized asset libraries

Graphic Design & Assets

  • Design marketing images, thumbnails, and social graphics
  • Create on-brand visual assets using Photoshop, Illustrator, or Canva

Project Management

  • Track assignments and status updates in ClickUp
  • Follow naming conventions and file organization protocols
  • Communicate proactively about timelines, blockers, and questions


Requirements

  • 3-5+ years of video editing experience, specializing in short-form content
  • Expert-level Adobe Premiere Pro skills (required)
  • Proven experience creating or editing Facebook/Instagram ads
  • Mid-level proficiency with Photoshop, Illustrator, or Canva
  • Strong fundamentals in typography, color theory, composition, and motion graphics
  • Fluent English — excellent written and verbal communication
  • Self-managed — strong time management and ability to meet daily/weekly deadlines
  • Proactive communicator — asks questions early, flags issues before they become problems
  • Portfolio required — you must submit a portfolio showcasing your video editing work. Applications without portfolios will not be considered.


Nice to Have

  • Background in DTC or e-commerce brands
  • Experience with remote collaboration tools (Slack, ClickUp, Frame.io, Notion)
  • Familiarity with performance marketing metrics and what makes ads convert


Tech Requirements

Computer: i7 processor (or equivalent) with 16GB RAM minimum

Internet: 100 Mbps download speed minimum

Schedule

Monday-Friday: 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM EST (1-hour break)

Required: Weekly team meeting on Thursdays at 10:00 AM EST



Benefits & Perks

  • Fully remote - work from anywhere in LATAM
  • Paid time off
  • Flex days. Enjoy an extra quarterly day off to unwind and recharge energies whenever you desire.
  • Professional development - opportunities to learn and grow with the business


Ready to Apply?

If you love creating high-performing video content and have a portfolio that showcases your work, we want to see it. Apply now.

Note: Applications without portfolio samples will not be reviewed.

Foundey is a strategic UI/UX design agency focused on SaaS, AI, and tech startups. We specialize in creating user experiences that align with business goals, driving growth and scalability for early-stage products. Our services include strategic UI/UX design, embedded design partnerships, UX audits, and MVP design sprints tailored for validation. Founders trust us for our deep understanding of startup challenges, combining cross-industry expertise in areas such as fintech and AI to deliver results that exceed design trends. Sobre a ília

Somos especialistas em tecnologia, dados e design, impulsionando a transformação digital de grandes players do mercado há mais de 10 anos, nos setores financeiro, seguros e mobilidade. Com mais de 450 profissionais, estamos presentes no Brasil e Europa, atendendo aos mercados da América Latina, Europa e América do Norte, desenvolvendo produtos digitais de alta qualidade e com foco em resultados de negócios. Certificada pelo 7° ano consecutivo como Great Place to work aqui na ília acreditamos que pessoas mudam o mundo, e investimos nelas. Nossas awesome deliveries são feitas de pessoas para pessoas, afinal awesome people make awesome deliveries!

#Vempraília!


Sobre a vaga:

O DevOps será responsável por projetar, implantar e manter soluções de monitoramento, telemetria e rastreabilidade em ambientes Azure, garantindo visibilidade completa sobre aplicações, containers e serviços serverless.


Responsabilidades:

  • Deverá configurar e integrar ferramentas como Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics e Container Insights, estabelecendo padrões de observabilidade que suportem o diagnóstico de incidentes, análise de desempenho e tomada de decisão baseada em dados.
  • Atuará na automação de monitoramento via IaC, integração com pipelines DevOps e na definição de métricas de confiabilidade (SLO/SLI/SLA) para aplicações críticas.
  • Será responsável por implementar e acompanhar métricas DORA (Deployment Frequency, Lead Time for Changes, Mean Time to Recovery e Change Failure Rate), promovendo uma cultura orientada a dados e melhoria contínua na entrega de software.


Requisitos:

  • Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, Container Insights.
  • Coleta e correlação de logs, métricas e traces.
  • Observabilidade em ambientes serverless (Functions, Logic Apps, App Services).
  • Observabilidade de containers e clusters AKS (Kubernetes).

A powerful Attack Surface Monitoring tool that gives visibility and intelligence on customers’ attack surfaces. CloudSEK's BeVigil uses a combination of Mobile, Web, Network and Encryption Scanners to map and protect known and unknown assets.

Key Milestones:


  • 2016: Launched our first product.

Job Description:

As a Customer Success Manager at CloudSEK , you will be the primary point of contact for a few strategic accounts, ensuring they derive maximum value from our cybersecurity solutions . Your role will involve deep engagement with clients , providing expert guidance on threat management, and ensuring seamless integration and utilization of CloudSEK’s products . Your background in cybersecurity will be crucial in understanding and addressing the specific needs and challenges faced by our clients.


Key Responsibilities:


Account Management:

  • Manage and nurture relationships for a client accounts, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and retention.
  • Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and Annual Business Reviews (ABRs) to assess and enhance customer engagement.
  • Visit customers twice a year to strengthen relationships and understand their evolving needs.

Cybersecurity Expertise:

  • Provide expert guidance on threat intelligence, data leak prevention, and other cybersecurity issues.

  • Collaborate with customer security teams to ensure optimal usage of CloudSEK’s solutions.

Customer Engagement:

  • Develop and execute customer engagement strategies to build strong relationships with key stakeholders, including CXOs and CISOs.
  • Foster customer champions within client organizations to drive advocacy and referrals.
  • Generate and share client-specific quality reports, gathering feedback to continuously improve service delivery.

Revenue Generation and Retention:

  • Identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling CloudSEK’s products and services.
  • Ensure on-time renewals and maintain a high customer retention rate.
  • Source referrals and participate in revenue generation activities.

Product Usage and Feedback:

  • Ensure 100% product usage for features subscribed by the customers.
  • Conduct configuration reviews and provide recommendations for product enhancements.
  • Gather and analyze customer feedback to contribute to product development and improvement.

Operational Excellence:

  • Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and activities in CRM systems.
  • Contribute to the team by sharing knowledge, conducting training sessions, and writing internal articles.


Ideal candidate:

  • 4-5 years of experience in Cybersecurity & Client-facing experience, or a related role in the cybersecurity industry.
  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity principles, threat intelligence, and digital risk management.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships with clients. Strong language proficiency over English and Portuguese is required.
  • Proven track record of achieving customer success goals and driving revenue growth.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple accounts simultaneously.


Cookie points if you have experience in the below skills:

  • Business reviews:
  • Onsite meetings
  • Maintaining NRR and GRR
  • Threat analysis and Value delivery


Benefits of Joining CloudSEK:

We provide an environment where you can develop and enhance your skills while delivering meaningful work that matters. You’ll be rewarded a competitive salary as well as a full spectrum of generous perks and incentives which include:


Flexible working hours.

Food, unlimited snacks and drinks are all available while at office.

And, the finest part is yet to come! Every now and then we ensure to unwind and have a good time together, which involves games, fun, and soulful music. Feel free to show off your artistic side here!


CloudSEK is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

  • You think recruiting is a high-leverage business function, not administrative work
  • You enjoy improving systems, processes, and sourcing quality over time

This Role Is NOT For You If:

  • You need constant direction or external motivation
  • You struggle with consistency and follow-through
  • You are uncomfortable persuading passive candidates
  • You treat recruiting as scheduling and coordination only


Compensation & Benefits

Uproot Clean is a high ownership, high accountability environment with high standards for communication, speed, execution, and quality. We care far more about ability, judgment, and ownership than credentials or years of experience.

  • Salary : Competitive base salary + performance-based bonus structure
  • Significant autonomy with the ability to directly influence the company’s growth and direction

title: Integration Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Integration Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Product

Anterior is on a mission to transform healthcare administration, making it seamless and invisible so clinicians can focus on delivering care. We’ve built an AI-powered platform designed by clinicians, for clinicians, to simplify administrative workflows and improve patient outcomes. By combining clinical expertise with cutting-edge technology, we’re revolutionizing healthcare operations with responsible AI.

We’re growing rapidly and are backed by world-class investors including Sequoia, New Enterprise Associates NEA, and Neo along with notable angels including the founders of DeepMind, Google AI, and Inflection AI.

Anterior is improving the experience of healthcare for everyone. We’re working on the cutting edge of using technology to make clinical decision-making frictionless.We’re building exciting tech for huge customers and we trust in the foundations: keep it simple, build strong foundations, and the rest will follow.


The Team

At Anterior, engineers share a strong “sense of product” and solve meaningful problems that simplify healthcare workflows. We collaborate in multidisciplinary teams to deliver secure, scalable, and user-focused solutions guided by best practices and modular design.

We’re building a dedicated deployments team focused on deploying our platform into large US enterprise healthcare environments. This team works closely with customers and our core platform engineers to ensure seamless, reliable integrations into complex payer systems of record.


About You

You have a passion for doing things The Right Way, you believe Less is More, you want to focus on the foundations of system design and architecture (pacelc, consistency guarantees), you care as much about the code you do not write, you’re tired of the hype treadmill and care about the fundamentals. You have battle scars from over-engineered and underperforming slop, and you care about writing code that lasts.

Your depth is in building integrations, APIs, and data pipelines that connect complex systems together reliably. You’ve worked with enterprise customers, dealt with messy data, conflicting sources of truth, and deduplication challenges.

You’ve owned integration design decisions end-to-end — from scoping requirements with a customer to shipping it to production and making sure it holds up. You may be coming from a health tech company, a scale-up doing enterprise deployments, or a platform team that built the connective tissue between systems — what matters is that you’ve navigated real integration complexity and you want ownership over what you build.


About the Role

Members of Technical Staff (Deployments) at Anterior own customer deployment problems end-to-end — from scoping integrations through to production. You’ll be the bridge between our AI platform and the enterprise healthcare systems it plugs into.

A day’s work may include:

  • Designing and building integrations, APIs, and data pipelines that connect our platform to customer systems of record EHRs, claims platforms, care management systems)
  • Working directly with US enterprise healthcare customers to understand their architecture, scope integration requirements, and translate them into technical specs
  • Building and maintaining FHIR, HL7, and custom API integrations with payer and health plan systems
  • Debugging data quality issues — conflicting sources of truth, deduplication, schema mismatches, and edge cases specific to healthcare data
  • Owning UAT testing end-to-end, working with customer IT teams to validate data flows before go-live
  • Building internal tooling and shared integration patterns that make the next deployment faster
  • Contributing to Anterior’s SDKs, developer documentation, and integration playbooks
  • Collaborating closely with the core platform team in New York to ensure integration needs inform platform architecture


Tech

  • Langs: Python / TS
  • Infra: Nix, AWS
  • Healthcare data: FHIR, HL7 (experience preferred but not required — you’ll learn fast if you have strong API and data pipeline fundamentals)


What we’re looking for

  • Strong backend engineering fundamentals — APIs, data pipelines, distributed systems
  • Experience integrating with enterprise systems, ideally in healthcare (payer, EHR, claims) but complex enterprise integrations in other industries count too
  • Comfort working directly with customers and translating ambiguous requirements into clean technical solutions
  • Experience with data quality challenges — deduplication, schema mapping, reconciliation across multiple sources of truth
  • Strong written and spoken communication in English — you’ll be collaborating with teams and customers across time zones
  • Ability to work autonomously from detailed technical specs while flagging blockers and ambiguity early
  • Timezone compatibility with US East Coast ET) working hours


What’s in it for you

This is an opportunity to join a company at its major inflection point, using cutting- edge technology to have a meaningful impact in healthcare. You’ll work with a world-class team, hold significant responsibility, and have the opportunity to learn and grow rapidly.


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule).
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.


As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.

title: Software Engineer- AI Integration
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Software Engineer- AI Integration em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Position : Software Engineer (AI Integration)

Location: Remote/Work From Home in Brazil

Employment Type : CLT

Monthly Salary Range: 10-22k Reais/month



Requirements:

-Working knowledge of Java (21+) and Spring Boot (REST APIs, Spring Data JPA, Spring Security)


-Experience with Oracle Database: SQL, joins, indexing, stored procedures, and JPA/Hibernate mapping


-Strong understanding of RESTful API design and documentation (OpenAPI/Swagger)


-Solid Python proficiency (async/await, type hints, virtual environments, packaging)


-Hands-on experience with at least one LLM orchestration framework (LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or equivalent)


-Experience consuming LLM APIs and applying prompt engineering best practices


-Exposure to agentic AI concepts: tool-calling, function calling, ReAct patterns, RAG, vector stores


-Familiari ty with FastAPI or similar frameworks for serving AI pipelines



Nice to have skills and experience:


-Experience with LangGraph specifically (stateful multi-agent graphs, conditional routing, checkpointing)


-Exposure to enterprise integrations: ServiceNow, LDAP/AD, Microsoft Graph API, JIRA, or similar


-Familiarity with observability tools: logging, tracing (LangSmith, OpenTelemetry), and metrics


-Exp erience with prompt testing frameworks or evals for LLM quality assurance


About the Role


We're looking for a Full Stack Engineer with a strong foundation across front-end, back-end, and AI/ML technologies to join a forward-thinking engineering team. In this role, you'll build and maintain web applications powered by modern frameworks while integrating cutting-edge AI capabilities — including Large Language Models (LLMs) and agentic AI patterns — into real-world business workflows. If you enjoy working across the entire stack and are excited about bringing AI from prototype to production, this is the role for you



What You'll Do

  • Build & maintain fron t-end interfaces using Angular (or equivalent component-based frameworks), delivering clean and responsive user experiences.


  • Develop back-end services in Java 21+ and Spring Boot, including REST APIs, data persistence with Spring Data JPA, and foundational security with Spring Security

description:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems.

Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L

  • Ability to run basic command-line commands (no advanced programming required).

  • Good written communication skills in English.

  • Flexible working hours and a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to contribute to impactful research initiatives.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.

  • Commitment Required: 30 hours per week minimum.
  • Engagement Type: Contractor/Freelancer (no medical or paid leave).

description:

About the Company

We are a leading digital asset platform that provides trading, brokerage, custody, and infrastructure solutions for institutional and professional investors. As the business continues to grow, they are seeking an experienced liquidity professional to lead and enhance their global liquidity capabilities.


Role Overview

This leadership role is responsible for overseeing liquidity strategy across digital asset and FX markets in LATAM, ensuring efficient market access, strong execution quality, and robust liquidity coverage across trading products. The successful candidate will work closely with Trading, Sales, Product, Risk, Compliance, Treasury, and Technology teams to support the firm's institutional trading business.


Key Responsibilities

Liquidity Management

  • Develop and execute the firm's liquidity strategy across digital asset and FX-related markets.
  • Source, onboard, and manage relationships with liquidity providers, market makers, brokers, exchanges, and banking partners.
  • Monitor liquidity quality, market depth, pricing competitiveness, and venue performance.
  • Ensure sufficient liquidity coverage across supported products and trading activities.


FX & Trading Operations

  • Oversee liquidity and execution across FX and digital asset trading flows.
  • Monitor market developments and identify opportunities to improve execution performance and pricing.
  • Analyze trading activity, transaction costs, spreads, and execution metrics.
  • Partner with trading and treasury teams to optimize execution workflows and market access.


Counterparty & Vendor Management

  • Build and maintain relationships with key liquidity providers and institutional counterparties.
  • Support commercial negotiations, fee discussions, and service-level reviews.
  • Conduct ongoing assessments and due diligence of trading venues and liquidity partners.


Risk & Governance

  • Work closely with Risk and Compliance teams to ensure appropriate controls and oversight.
  • Monitor counterparty, settlement, and liquidity-related risks.
  • Support contingency planning and business continuity measures during periods of market stress.


Leadership & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Lead and develop the liquidity function.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders across Trading, Treasury, Product, Technology, Risk, and Compliance teams.
  • Provide management reporting on liquidity performance, market developments, and strategic initiatives.


Requirements

  • Significant experience in liquidity management, electronic trading, FX trading, market structure, market making, brokerage, or institutional trading environments.
  • Experience sourcing, evaluating, and managing relationships with liquidity providers, brokers, market makers, exchanges, and banking partners.
  • Strong understanding of FX and/or digital asset liquidity ecosystems and execution practices.
  • Ability to analyze execution quality, transaction costs, and liquidity performance metrics.
  • Commercially minded with strong negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience working within regulated financial services environments.
  • Excellent communication, leadership, and relationship management capabilities.

description:

This is a fully remote position, PJ model and salary range is 30-40/hr USD.


Required Skills & Experience


  • Expert-level experience with time series analysis, including working with sequential/temporal data, identifying trends and seasonality, detecting anomalies, and building forecasting/predictive models (ARIMA, Prophet, LSTM, or similar) for real-world applications such as predictive maintenance
  • Strong hands-on experience building and applying machine learning models across multiple techniques, with a solid foundation in statistics and data science principles
  • Proven ability to translate complex data science concepts into clear, practical insights for business stakeholders, balancing both technical depth and business context

Nice to Have Skills & Experience

Job Description


Insight Global is searching for a highly skilled Data Scientist to sit in Latin America for one of its largest oil & gas compression services clients in Houston, TX. This person will be responsible for building and optimizing advanced machine learning models focused on predictive maintenance, with a strong emphasis on time series data analysis. They will leverage Python/PySpark in environments such as Microsoft Azure/Fabric, Jupyter Notebooks, and VS Code to develop and refine models, while also working closely with business stakeholders to translate complex statistical concepts and model outputs into clear, actionable insights. title: Integration Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Integration Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Product

Anterior is on a mission to transform healthcare administration, making it seamless and invisible so clinicians can focus on delivering care. We’ve built an AI-powered platform designed by clinicians, for clinicians, to simplify administrative workflows and improve patient outcomes. By combining clinical expertise with cutting-edge technology, we’re revolutionizing healthcare operations with responsible AI.

We’re growing rapidly and are backed by world-class investors including Sequoia, New Enterprise Associates NEA, and Neo along with notable angels including the founders of DeepMind, Google AI, and Inflection AI.

Anterior is improving the experience of healthcare for everyone. We’re working on the cutting edge of using technology to make clinical decision-making frictionless.We’re building exciting tech for huge customers and we trust in the foundations: keep it simple, build strong foundations, and the rest will follow.


The Team

At Anterior, engineers share a strong “sense of product” and solve meaningful problems that simplify healthcare workflows. We collaborate in multidisciplinary teams to deliver secure, scalable, and user-focused solutions guided by best practices and modular design.

We’re building a dedicated deployments team focused on deploying our platform into large US enterprise healthcare environments. This team works closely with customers and our core platform engineers to ensure seamless, reliable integrations into complex payer systems of record.


About You

You have a passion for doing things The Right Way, you believe Less is More, you want to focus on the foundations of system design and architecture (pacelc, consistency guarantees), you care as much about the code you do not write, you’re tired of the hype treadmill and care about the fundamentals. You have battle scars from over-engineered and underperforming slop, and you care about writing code that lasts.

Your depth is in building integrations, APIs, and data pipelines that connect complex systems together reliably. You’ve worked with enterprise customers, dealt with messy data, conflicting sources of truth, and deduplication challenges.

You’ve owned integration design decisions end-to-end — from scoping requirements with a customer to shipping it to production and making sure it holds up. You may be coming from a health tech company, a scale-up doing enterprise deployments, or a platform team that built the connective tissue between systems — what matters is that you’ve navigated real integration complexity and you want ownership over what you build.


About the Role

Members of Technical Staff (Deployments) at Anterior own customer deployment problems end-to-end — from scoping integrations through to production. You’ll be the bridge between our AI platform and the enterprise healthcare systems it plugs into.

A day’s work may include:

  • Designing and building integrations, APIs, and data pipelines that connect our platform to customer systems of record EHRs, claims platforms, care management systems)
  • Working directly with US enterprise healthcare customers to understand their architecture, scope integration requirements, and translate them into technical specs
  • Building and maintaining FHIR, HL7, and custom API integrations with payer and health plan systems
  • Debugging data quality issues — conflicting sources of truth, deduplication, schema mismatches, and edge cases specific to healthcare data
  • Owning UAT testing end-to-end, working with customer IT teams to validate data flows before go-live
  • Building internal tooling and shared integration patterns that make the next deployment faster
  • Contributing to Anterior’s SDKs, developer documentation, and integration playbooks
  • Collaborating closely with the core platform team in New York to ensure integration needs inform platform architecture


Tech

  • Langs: Python / TS
  • Infra: Nix, AWS
  • Healthcare data: FHIR, HL7 (experience preferred but not required — you’ll learn fast if you have strong API and data pipeline fundamentals)


What we’re looking for

  • Strong backend engineering fundamentals — APIs, data pipelines, distributed systems
  • Experience integrating with enterprise systems, ideally in healthcare (payer, EHR, claims) but complex enterprise integrations in other industries count too
  • Comfort working directly with customers and translating ambiguous requirements into clean technical solutions
  • Experience with data quality challenges — deduplication, schema mapping, reconciliation across multiple sources of truth
  • Strong written and spoken communication in English — you’ll be collaborating with teams and customers across time zones
  • Ability to work autonomously from detailed technical specs while flagging blockers and ambiguity early
  • Timezone compatibility with US East Coast ET) working hours


What’s in it for you

This is an opportunity to join a company at its major inflection point, using cutting- edge technology to have a meaningful impact in healthcare. You’ll work with a world-class team, hold significant responsibility, and have the opportunity to learn and grow rapidly.


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule).
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.


As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.

title: Software Engineer- AI Integration
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Software Engineer- AI Integration em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Position : Software Engineer (AI Integration)

Location: Remote/Work From Home in Brazil

Employment Type : CLT

Monthly Salary Range: 10-22k Reais/month



Requirements:

-Working knowledge of Java (21+) and Spring Boot (REST APIs, Spring Data JPA, Spring Security)


-Experience with Oracle Database: SQL, joins, indexing, stored procedures, and JPA/Hibernate mapping


-Strong understanding of RESTful API design and documentation (OpenAPI/Swagger)


-Solid Python proficiency (async/await, type hints, virtual environments, packaging)


-Hands-on experience with at least one LLM orchestration framework (LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or equivalent)


-Experience consuming LLM APIs and applying prompt engineering best practices


-Exposure to agentic AI concepts: tool-calling, function calling, ReAct patterns, RAG, vector stores


-Familiari ty with FastAPI or similar frameworks for serving AI pipelines



Nice to have skills and experience:


-Experience with LangGraph specifically (stateful multi-agent graphs, conditional routing, checkpointing)


-Exposure to enterprise integrations: ServiceNow, LDAP/AD, Microsoft Graph API, JIRA, or similar


-Familiarity with observability tools: logging, tracing (LangSmith, OpenTelemetry), and metrics


-Exp erience with prompt testing frameworks or evals for LLM quality assurance


About the Role


We're looking for a Full Stack Engineer with a strong foundation across front-end, back-end, and AI/ML technologies to join a forward-thinking engineering team. In this role, you'll build and maintain web applications powered by modern frameworks while integrating cutting-edge AI capabilities — including Large Language Models (LLMs) and agentic AI patterns — into real-world business workflows. If you enjoy working across the entire stack and are excited about bringing AI from prototype to production, this is the role for you



What You'll Do

  • Build & maintain fron t-end interfaces using Angular (or equivalent component-based frameworks), delivering clean and responsive user experiences.


  • Develop back-end services in Java 21+ and Spring Boot, including REST APIs, data persistence with Spring Data JPA, and foundational security with Spring Security


  • Design and manage database interactions with Oracle Database — writing optimized SQL, managing joins, indexing, stored procedures, and JPA/Hibernate entity mappings.


  • Architect and document RESTful APIs following best practices, with clear documentation via OpenAPI/Swagger.


  • Build and deploy AI/ML pipelines in Python, leveraging LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or similar) and serving them through FastAPI or equivalent frameworks.


  • Integrate LLM APIs (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, Cohere, etc.) into applications using prompt engineering best practices.


  • Implement agentic AI patterns including tool-calling, function calling, ReAct workflows, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and vector store integrations.


  • Translate ambiguous b usiness problems into clear technical requirements by interpreting SOPs, process documents, and workflow diagrams.


  • Collaborate cross-functionally in an Agile team environment, communicating technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) Sênior em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) para atuar em um ambiente desafiador, contribuindo diretamente para a confiabilidade, escalabilidade e performance de sistemas críticos.


Principais Responsabilidades


  • Definir e evoluir SLIs, SLOs e Error Budgets para serviços críticos.
  • Implantar e manter observabilidade ponta a ponta (métricas, logs, traces e alertas).

  • Fortalecer processos de deploy seguro utilizando CI/CD, rollback, canary releases e feature flags.
  • Promover uma cultura de melhoria contínua, aprendizado e gestão blameless de incidentes.


✅ Requisitos Obrigatórios


  • Experiência com operação de sistemas distribuídos em ambientes Cloud (AWS ou Azure).
  • Vivência com Kubernetes e containers em produção.
  • Conhecimento sólido em observabilidade utilizando ferramentas como Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/OpenSearch, Dynatrace SaaS ou similares.
  • Experiência com Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform, Pulumi ou equivalentes).
  • Conhecimento em automação através de Python, Go, Bash ou linguagens similares.
  • Experiência com pipelines de CI/CD utilizando GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins ou Azure DevOps.


⭐ Diferenciais


  • Experiência em ambientes regulados, especialmente nos segmentos financeiro ou de crédito.
  • Conhecimento em práticas de FinOps e otimização de custos em nuvem.
  • Experiência com Chaos Engineering e testes de resiliência.

Auxílio Home Office Ticket;

title: Digital Workplace Manager (Hands-on, M365 / Azure)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Digital Workplace Manager (Hands-on, M365 / Azure) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Summary

We are looking for a hands-on Digital Workplace Manager to lead and strengthen our workplace technology function. This role is a blend of people leadership, technical oversight, and senior-level contribution across Microsoft 365 and related Azure services.

The right person will be comfortable managing a small team while still staying close to the technology. They will help set direction, mentor engineers, support escalations, improve service quality, and drive delivery across the Microsoft workplace stack.

Key Responsibilities

Team leadership and people management

  • Lead a small Digital Workplace team responsible for Microsoft 365 and related workplace platforms
  • Provide day-to-day direction, coaching, mentoring, and performance support for team members
  • Act as the main escalation point for complex operational and technical issues
  • Help define team structure, role clarity, and ways of working
  • Identify hiring needs and support recruitment, onboarding, and development of additional engineers

Technical leadership

  • Provide hands-on leadership across Microsoft 365 technologies such as Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Intune, Entra ID, and related services
  • Support solution design, technical decision-making, and engineering standards across the team
  • Partner with Azure-focused team members on integrations, identity, automation, security, and cloud-native services
  • Review technical designs and changes to ensure scalability, supportability, and alignment with business needs
  • Stay close enough to the environment to troubleshoot major issues and guide senior technicians through complex work

Service ownership and delivery

  • Own the health, stability, and continuous improvement of Digital Workplace services
  • Balance operational support, project delivery, and longer-term modernization efforts
  • Work with business and IT stakeholders to understand priorities and translate them into actionable plans
  • Establish and improve processes for support, change management, documentation, and service transitions
  • Track delivery, risks, dependencies, and service issues, and communicate clearly to leadership

Required Experience

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with Microsoft 365 technologies in engineering, administration, or architecture roles
  • 2+ years of team leadership, people management, or technical leadership experience
  • Strong practical knowledge of core Microsoft 365 services, especially:
  • Exchange Online
  • Teams 
  • SharePoint Online
  • OneDrive 
  • Intune 
  • Entra ID
  • Experience working with Azure AI Foundry
  • Understanding of AI-driven workplace transformation, automation, and end-user enablement within Microsoft 365 environments
  • Experience leading technical delivery in production environments
  • Experience handling escalations, coordinating cross-team work, and improving service operations
  • Experience mentoring engineers and helping develop technical capability within a team 
  • Ability to communicate clearly with both technical teams and business stakeholders 

Azure Knowledge Expected

The role does not need to be the deepest Azure engineer on the team, but the person should have solid working knowledge of Azure in areas such as:

  • Azure identity and access concepts
  • Azure governance and resource organization
  • Integration between Azure and Microsoft 365 services
  • Automation and cloud services relevant to workplace solutions
  • Basic understanding of Azure-native services used alongside M365 environments

They should be able to guide conversations, challenge designs, make informed decisions, and work effectively with senior Azure engineers.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Power Platform, Power Automate, or RPA-focused initiatives
  • Experience with Microsoft security and compliance capabilities within M365
  • Experience with Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI, or workplace AI initiatives
  • Experience with hybrid identity and legacy-to-cloud migration efforts
  • Experience building or leading service improvement programs
  • Microsoft certifications related to M365, Azure, security, or modern workplace

title: Talent Acquisition Partner
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Talent Acquisition Partner em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Talent Acquisition Partner (Active Sourcing)


Location: Fully Remote (Must be based in LATAM)

Job Type: Full-Time



About Uproot Clean

Uproot Clean is a fast-growing consumer products company with more than 5 million customers using our products. Our products are sold not only through DTC and Amazon, but also through major retailers, including Walmart, Target, and Petco, along with more than 10,000 retail doors across the country. Uproot has also been featured across major television and media platforms, including QVC, Good Morning America, and Fox, helping introduce millions of consumers to the brand.

We care deeply about building products that genuinely solve problems for pet owners while operating with high standards across every part of the business. We are building a company focused on long-term excellence, creating significant opportunities for highly capable people who want real and meaningful impact, and the ability to help shape the future of the company.

About the Role

This is a hands-on execution role focused 100% on active sourcing. You will proactively identify and engage high-quality talent across multiple functions and seniority levels using multiple sourcing channels, advanced search techniques, and thoughtful outreach.

Success requires high-output execution, strong judgment, persistence, excellent communication, and the ability to operate with urgency in a fast-moving environment.



Responsibilities


Active Sourcing

  • Proactively source candidates across multiple job boards, platforms, and sourcing channels
  • Use advanced Boolean search techniques to identify strong talent
  • Build pipelines across multiple functions and seniority levels
  • Identify strong passive candidates
  • Partner closely with recruiting and hiring managers to align on hiring needs.

Candidate Outreach

  • Write outbound messaging that drives candidate engagement
  • Qualify candidates early in the process
  • Move qualified candidates into the recruiting workflow

Pipeline Management

  • Maintain organized sourcing workflows and candidate tracking
  • Continuously improve sourcing strategies and outreach quality
  • Continuously iterate on sourcing methods, messaging, and targeting

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistently builds high-quality candidate pipelines
  • Surfaces strong candidates quickly across multiple functions
  • Generates strong response and assessment completion rates
  • Operates with speed, consistency, and minimal oversight
  • Raises the overall talent bar of the company over time


Requirements

Must Have

  • 1+ year of full-time active sourcing experience - mandatory
  • Experience sourcing across multiple job boards and sourcing platforms
  • Strong outbound recruiting and candidate outreach skills
  • Experience using advanced Boolean search techniques
  • Excellent written English communication skills
  • Ability to manage multiple open searches simultaneously

Strong Plus

  • Experience sourcing across multiple functions and seniority levels
  • Experience in high-growth, e-commerce, or performance-driven companies
  • Familiarity with LinkedIn Recruiter and modern sourcing tools

Work Requirements

⏰ Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST

Workspace: Fixed, professional setup (no digital nomads)

Output: Daily briefs and feedback loops (high consistency required)


Who This Role Is For (& Not For)

This Role Is For You If:

  • You enjoy the challenge of finding exceptional people before anyone else does
  • You are naturally proactive and internally driven
  • You move quickly, stay organized, and maintain high standards
  • You enjoy performance-oriented environments with accountability
  • You think recruiting is a high-leverage business function, not administrative work
  • You enjoy improving systems, processes, and sourcing quality over time

This Role Is NOT For You If:

  • You need constant direction or external motivation
  • You struggle with consistency and follow-through
  • You are uncomfortable persuading passive candidates
  • You treat recruiting as scheduling and coordination only


Compensation & Benefits

Uproot Clean is a high ownership, high accountability environment with high standards for communication, speed, execution, and quality. We care far more about ability, judgment, and ownership than credentials or years of experience.

  • Salary : Competitive base salary + performance-based bonus structure
  • Significant autonomy with the ability to directly influence the company’s growth and direction
  • Fully remote : work from anywhere
  • PTO : 2 Weeks
  • Flex Day : An additional quarterly day off dedicated to rest and recovery
  • Thinking Day: one dedicated day each quarter to step away from day-to-day execution and think deeply about your role, systems, ideas, and long-term impact
  • Wellness Reimbursement: $100-$300/month, based on location, to help support your wellness.
  • Pet Reimbursement: $40-100/month, based on location to help support parenting a pet.
  • Coaching credits: $1,000+/year for coaching, education, and professional development


Ready to Apply?

If you are excited by high standards, proactive recruiting, and the challenge of building world-class talent pipelines, we’d love to hear from you.
