title: Head of Liquidity LATAM
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Head of Liquidity LATAM em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Company

We are a leading digital asset platform that provides trading, brokerage, custody, and infrastructure solutions for institutional and professional investors. As the business continues to grow, they are seeking an experienced liquidity professional to lead and enhance their global liquidity capabilities.


Role Overview

This leadership role is responsible for overseeing liquidity strategy across digital asset and FX markets in LATAM, ensuring efficient market access, strong execution quality, and robust liquidity coverage across trading products. The successful candidate will work closely with Trading, Sales, Product, Risk, Compliance, Treasury, and Technology teams to support the firm's institutional trading business. We cover stablecoins, on/off ramp and cross-border payments as well. Candidates with relevant experiences will be prioritized.


Key Responsibilities

Liquidity Management

  • Develop and execute the firm's liquidity strategy across digital asset and FX-related markets.
  • Source, onboard, and manage relationships with liquidity providers, market makers, brokers, exchanges, and banking partners.
  • Monitor liquidity quality, market depth, pricing competitiveness, and venue performance.
  • Ensure sufficient liquidity coverage across supported products and trading activities.


FX & Trading Operations

  • Oversee liquidity and execution across FX and digital asset trading flows.
  • Monitor market developments and identify opportunities to improve execution performance and pricing.
  • Analyze trading activity, transaction costs, spreads, and execution metrics.
  • Partner with trading and treasury teams to optimize execution workflows and market access.


Counterparty & Vendor Management

  • Build and maintain relationships with key liquidity providers and institutional counterparties.
  • Support commercial negotiations, fee discussions, and service-level reviews.
  • Conduct ongoing assessments and due diligence of trading venues and liquidity partners.


Risk & Governance

  • Work closely with Risk and Compliance teams to ensure appropriate controls and oversight.
  • Monitor counterparty, settlement, and liquidity-related risks.
  • Support contingency planning and business continuity measures during periods of market stress.


Leadership & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Lead and develop the liquidity function.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders across Trading, Treasury, Product, Technology, Risk, and Compliance teams.
  • Provide management reporting on liquidity performance, market developments, and strategic initiatives.


Requirements

  • Significant experience in liquidity management, electronic trading, FX trading, market structure, market making, brokerage, or institutional trading environments.
  • Experience sourcing, evaluating, and managing relationships with liquidity providers, brokers, market makers, exchanges, and banking partners.
  • Strong understanding of FX and/or digital asset liquidity ecosystems and execution practices.
  • Ability to analyze execution quality, transaction costs, and liquidity performance metrics.
  • Commercially minded with strong negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience working within regulated financial services environments.
  • Excellent communication, leadership, and relationship management capabilities.

title: Remote Business Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Business Analyst em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems.

Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


About the Role:

We are looking for a detail-oriented Business Analyst to support evaluation and annotation workflows focused on quality, accuracy, and structured reasoning. This role is ideal for someone who is comfortable working with digital tools, performing side-by-side evaluations, and providing clear, well-supported justifications based on fact-checking.


Responsibilities:

  • Perform side-by-side (SxS) evaluations on GHD, comparing outputs and assessing quality, accuracy, and relevance.
  • Conduct fact-checking to validate information and identify inconsistencies or inaccuracies.
  • Provide detailed, well-structured justifications to support evaluation decisions.
  • Follow established evaluation guidelines and quality standards consistently.
  • Use browser-based tools and extensions to support analysis and review tasks.
  • Execute simple command-line instructions when required to support evaluation workflows.
  • Document findings clearly and communicate insights to stakeholders when needed.


Requirements:

  • Solid comfort using a computer in a professional setting.
  • Experience working with browser extensions and online tools.
  • Ability to run basic command-line commands (no advanced programming required).
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
  • High attention to detail and ability to justify decisions clearly and objectively.
  • Comfortable working with evaluation frameworks, comparisons, and structured analysis.
  • Good written communication skills in English.


Nice to Have:

  • Previous experience with evaluation, annotation, QA, or audit-type work.
  • Familiarity with data quality, content evaluation, or model/output assessments.
  • Background in business analysis, operations, or process improvement.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to contribute to impactful research initiatives.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitment Required: 30 hours per week minimum.
  • Engagement Type: Contractor/Freelancer (no medical or paid leave).
  • Time Overlap: Some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2–5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles.


Application Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete an analytical challenge.
  • Once the assessment is cleared, you’re ready to start contributing!


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack Sênior (Plataforma de RH e DP)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack Sênior (Plataforma de RH e DP) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack Sênior para ser um pilar técnico no desenvolvimento e evolução dos nossos produtos corporativos, com foco principal na criação da nossa nova plataforma interna de Recursos Humanos e Departamento Pessoal. Em um ambiente dinâmico de uma empresa de gestão de saúde, sua missão é atuar de ponta a ponta na construção de soluções de alto impacto.


Você liderará tecnicamente o desenvolvimento de um ecossistema completo que gerenciará a jornada dos nossos colaboradores, desde a admissão virtual e gestão de ponto eletrônico, até o processamento complexo da folha de pagamento. Além de escrever código escalável e de alta qualidade utilizando o ecossistema Node.js e React, você deverá liderar pelo exemplo, mentorar outros desenvolvedores e ditar os padrões de arquitetura da equipe.



Principais Responsabilidades


  • Arquitetura e Desenvolvimento: Projetar e desenvolver aplicações full stack de alta complexidade, implementando padrões de arquitetura definidos e garantindo a consistência do código.
  • Desenvolvimento de Módulos Core (RH/DP):
  • Criar fluxos de Admissão automatizados e seguros.
  • Construir e manter o motor de cálculo da Folha de Pagamento e Rescisões, garantindo precisão absoluta.
  • Desenvolver a gestão de Férias e o processamento de marcações de Ponto Eletrônico.
  • Legislação e Integrações: Traduzir regras da CLT e acordos sindicais em lógicas de sistema. Criar integrações robustas com sistemas bancários, APIs contábeis e órgãos governamentais (ex: e-Social), além de atuar no design de APIs (REST).
  • Liderança e Mentoria: Mentorar desenvolvedores(as) de nível pleno e júnior, realizando code reviews construtivos e disseminando boas práticas de mercado.
  • Automação e Qualidade: Garantir a qualidade através da implementação de uma estratégia sólida de testes automatizados (unitários, integração, e2e) e utilizar ativamente ferramentas de IA para geração de código, visando produtividade.
  • Infraestrutura e Deploy: Trabalhar com Docker para manter ambientes consistentes e atuar ativamente em esteiras de CI/CD para entregas contínuas.



Formação e Experiência


  • Experiência Específica em RH: Experiência comprovada na construção de sistemas de Recursos Humanos (HCM/HRMS), Departamento Pessoal, Workforce Management (ponto/escalas) ou plataformas de processamento financeiro complexo.
  • Experiência Técnica: Sólida vivência em desenvolvimento full stack corporativo, atuando de ponta a ponta na concepção de produtos.
  • Metodologias: Sólida vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) em times de produto, além de entendimento claro de workflows como GitFlow.
  • Formação: Ensino Superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou experiência prática equivalente.



Habilidades Técnicas (Hard Skills)


  • Stack Principal: Domínio avançado do ecossistema Node.js (NestJS, Express) e React (incluindo Next.js). Familiaridade com TypeScript e Vue.js.
  • Bancos de Dados: Proficiência em bancos relacionais (PostgreSQL, MySQL), ORMs, modelagem de tabelas e entendimento profundo de DER, além de transações consistentes.
  • DevOps & Cloud: Excelente conhecimento em Docker e ambiente Linux. Vivência prática com provedores Cloud (GCP, Azure) e cultura DevOps (CI/CD).
  • Ferramentas: Proficiência com Git/GitHub e experiência no uso de ferramentas de IA assistiva (como Claude Code ou similares).

title: Data Scientist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Scientist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

This is a fully remote position, PJ model and salary range is 30-40/hr USD.


Required Skills & Experience


  • Expert-level experience with time series analysis, including working with sequential/temporal data, identifying trends and seasonality, detecting anomalies, and building forecasting/predictive models (ARIMA, Prophet, LSTM, or similar) for real-world applications such as predictive maintenance
  • Strong hands-on experience building and applying machine learning models across multiple techniques, with a solid foundation in statistics and data science principles
  • Proven ability to translate complex data science concepts into clear, practical insights for business stakeholders, balancing both technical depth and business context
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to present findings clearly and confidently
  • Proficiency in Python (and/or PySpark) for data analysis and model development
  • Experience working in cloud environments such as Azure (preferred), AWS, or Databricks; familiarity with Microsoft Fabric is a plus


Nice to Have Skills & Experience


  • Oil and Gas Experience


Job Description


Insight Global is searching for a highly skilled Data Scientist to sit in Latin America for one of its largest oil & gas compression services clients in Houston, TX. This person will be responsible for building and optimizing advanced machine learning models focused on predictive maintenance, with a strong emphasis on time series data analysis. They will leverage Python/PySpark in environments such as Microsoft Azure/Fabric, Jupyter Notebooks, and VS Code to develop and refine models, while also working closely with business stakeholders to translate complex statistical concepts and model outputs into clear, actionable insights. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of machine learning and deep learning techniques, strong communication skills, and the ability to explain the “why” behind their work in a simplified way to non-technical audiences.

title: Senior Bookkeeper
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Bookkeeper em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Our client is a growing construction company headquartered in Miami, Florida, seeking a highly organized and experienced Senior Bookkeeper to help strengthen and optimize its financial operations.


This position is ideal for a detail-oriented accounting professional with strong bookkeeping expertise, hands-on experience with QuickBooks, and the ability to improve processes and implement scalable financial controls.


The successful candidate will play a key role in maintaining accurate financial records, streamlining accounting workflows, and supporting collaboration across internal teams.


Experience in the construction industry is considered a strong advantage.


Key Responsibilities


  • Manage the company's day-to-day bookkeeping and accounting operations.
  • Maintain accurate financial records, ensuring compliance with accounting standards and internal policies.
  • Handle accounts payable and accounts receivable processes.
  • Perform bank, credit card, and balance sheet reconciliations.
  • Prepare monthly financial reports and support month-end and year-end closing activities.
  • Maintain and optimize accounting records within QuickBooks.
  • Monitor cash flow and assist with financial planning activities.
  • Review and improve accounting workflows, controls, and operational processes.
  • Support the implementation of scalable systems and best practices as the company grows.
  • Coordinate with internal stakeholders, external accountants, payroll providers, and other financial partners.
  • Assist with budgeting, expense tracking, and financial reporting requirements.
  • Ensure proper documentation and organization of financial transactions and supporting records.
  • Identify process improvement opportunities and recommend operational efficiencies.


Qualifications


  • Proven experience in bookkeeping, accounting, or financial operations.
  • Strong proficiency in QuickBooks.
  • Solid understanding of accounts payable, accounts receivable, reconciliations, and financial reporting.
  • Experience supporting month-end close processes.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • High attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • Advanced or fluent English communication skills.
  • Experience in the construction industry is a plus.


This is an excellent opportunity to join a growing U.S. company and contribute directly to the development of scalable financial processes and operational excellence.

title: Scrum Master SR
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Scrum Master SR em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Na Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global.


Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!

Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

O que esperamos que você realize:

  • Facilitar e conduzir cerimônias ágeis, garantindo sua efetividade e alinhamento aos objetivos do time (Daily, Planning, Review, Retrospective, Refinements e demais eventos necessários).
  • Atuar como Servant Leader , removendo impedimentos e apoiando o desenvolvimento e autonomia da equipe.
  • Promover a evolução da maturidade ágil dos times e disseminar a cultura ágil em toda a organização.
  • Apoiar Product Owners e stakeholders na gestão e priorização do backlog, garantindo alinhamento entre estratégia e execução.
  • Garantir transparência, previsibilidade e visibilidade das entregas por meio de indicadores e acompanhamento contínuo.
  • Monitorar, analisar e impulsionar métricas ágeis como Velocity, Lead Time, Cycle Time, Throughput, CFD e outras métricas relevantes.
  • Identificar riscos, dependências e gargalos, atuando preventivamente para minimizar impactos.
  • Facilitar a comunicação entre times, áreas de negócio e stakeholders, promovendo alinhamento e colaboração.
  • Estimular práticas de melhoria contínua, aprendizado constante e excelência operacional.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de transformação ágil, contribuindo para a evolução dos processos e modelos de trabalho.
  • Atuar em ambientes com múltiplos times, promovendo sincronização e gestão eficiente de dependências.

Requisitos e qualificações

O que precisamos que você tenha de conhecimento:

  • Experiência sólida como Scrum Master em times de desenvolvimento de software e produtos digitais.
  • Conhecimento prático em frameworks e metodologias ágeis, como Scrum, Kanban, Lean, SAFe ou similares.
  • Vivência com ferramentas de gestão ágil, como Jira, Azure DevOps, GitLab, Trello ou equivalentes.
  • Experiência na definição, acompanhamento e análise de métricas ágeis orientadas a dados.
  • Conhecimento de práticas de engenharia de software, incluindo DevOps, CI/CD, testes automatizados e entrega contínua.
  • Forte habilidade de facilitação, mediação de conflitos e condução de workshops.
  • Capacidade de influenciar stakeholders e liderar mudanças organizacionais.
  • Experiência atuando com times distribuídos, remotos ou em estruturas escaladas.


Diferenciais:

  • Certificações ágeis como PSM, CSM, SAFe, KMP, PMI-ACP ou equivalentes.
  • Experiência em ambientes de transformação ágil organizacional.
  • Vivência com múltiplos squads e estruturas escaladas.
  • Conhecimento em OKRs, métricas de produto e gestão orientada a resultados.
  • Experiência em interação direta com áreas de negócio e clientes.
  • Atuação prévia em empresas de tecnologia, produtos digitais ou ambientes de alta complexidade.

Informações adicionais

Vale-alimentação ou vale-refeição;

Desconto em cursos, universidades e instituições de idiomas;

Academia Stefanini — plataforma com cursos on-line, gratuitos, atualizados e com certificado;

Mentoring;

Assistência médica;

title: Remote Business Analyst (German)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Business Analyst (German) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Senior Google Security Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Google Security Specialist em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the role:  

We are seeking a senior-level professional with strong expertise in cybersecurity architecture and advisory, with proven experience in large-scale security transformation programs. 

This individual will be responsible for leading both technically and strategically the migration between security platforms, acting as an advisor, architect, and program leader. 


A strong end-to-end vision of enterprise security is essential, along with deep knowledge of Microsoft and Google environments, and the ability to drive decisions in complex, global environments. 

Responsibilities  


  • Lead and advise the end-to-end migration strategy from Microsoft security tools to Google security tools, including current state assessment, future architecture design, roadmap creation, sequencing, and transition execution.  
  • Assess and map Microsoft security capabilities such as Entra ID, Defender, Sentinel, Purview, and Intune to relevant Google capabilities, including Google Cloud security services, Google SecOps, Mandiant, Chrome Enterprise, Google Workspace security, and identity and access controls.  
  • Define migration waves, dependencies, technical designs, and coexistence models to minimize business disruption and maintain security coverage throughout the transition.  
  • Design and oversee implementation of controls across identity, endpoint, cloud security, data protection, security operations, threat detection, incident response, posture management, and governance.  
  • Lead workshops with stakeholders from security, infrastructure, cloud, workspace, compliance, and executive leadership to align requirements, risks, architectural decisions, and operating model changes.  
  • Develop security architecture documentation, migration runbooks, control mappings, risk registers, executive committee updates, and implementation plans.  
  • Guide the integration of Google telemetry, detection content, and security workflows into Security Operations processes, including use cases, alerts, playbooks, and incident response procedures.  
  • Support the redesign of policies and controls aligned with Zero Trust principles, regulatory requirements, and internal governance standards.  
  • Provide technical leadership to project teams, partner resources, and client teams, including knowledge transfer, quality assurance, and issue resolution.  
  • Track delivery milestones, risks, assumptions, and decisions, and communicate progress clearly to senior leadership. 

Mandatory Requirements  


  • 8+ years of experience in cybersecurity consulting, security architecture, or security transformation programs.  
  • Proven experience leading large-scale security migrations or platform transformations in enterprise environments.  
  • Strong expertise in Google security technologies, including Google Cloud security architecture, Google SecOps, Mandiant capabilities, Chrome Enterprise security controls, Workspace security, IAM, and cloud-native monitoring and response capabilities.  
  • Strong hands-on knowledge of Microsoft security technologies, including Entra ID, Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Office 365, Defender for Identity, Defender for Cloud Apps, Sentinel, Purview, and Intune.  
  • Experience designing security controls across identity, endpoint, cloud, SaaS, data protection, SIEM/SOAR, vulnerability management, and incident response domains.  
  • Experience with Zero Trust architecture, security governance, regulatory compliance, and enterprise risk management.  
  • Strong program and project leadership skills, including stakeholder management, workshops facilitation, planning, and cross-functional team coordination.  
  • Fluent English, with excellent verbal and written communication skills. 

Additional Information  


  • Employment type: CLT (full-time employee) with flexible benefits  
  • Work model: Remote  
  • English fluency is mandatory; CV must be submitted in English.

title: Senior Google Security Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Google Security Specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the role:  

We are seeking a senior-level professional with strong expertise in cybersecurity architecture and advisory, with proven experience in large-scale security transformation programs. 

This individual will be responsible for leading both technically and strategically the migration between security platforms, acting as an advisor, architect, and program leader. 


A strong end-to-end vision of enterprise security is essential, along with deep knowledge of Microsoft and Google environments, and the ability to drive decisions in complex, global environments. 

Responsibilities  


  • Lead and advise the end-to-end migration strategy from Microsoft security tools to Google security tools, including current state assessment, future architecture design, roadmap creation, sequencing, and transition execution.  
  • Assess and map Microsoft security capabilities such as Entra ID, Defender, Sentinel, Purview, and Intune to relevant Google capabilities, including Google Cloud security services, Google SecOps, Mandiant, Chrome Enterprise, Google Workspace security, and identity and access controls.  
  • Define migration waves, dependencies, technical designs, and coexistence models to minimize business disruption and maintain security coverage throughout the transition.  
  • Design and oversee implementation of controls across identity, endpoint, cloud security, data protection, security operations, threat detection, incident response, posture management, and governance.  
  • Lead workshops with stakeholders from security, infrastructure, cloud, workspace, compliance, and executive leadership to align requirements, risks, architectural decisions, and operating model changes.  
  • Develop security architecture documentation, migration runbooks, control mappings, risk registers, executive committee updates, and implementation plans.  
  • Guide the integration of Google telemetry, detection content, and security workflows into Security Operations processes, including use cases, alerts, playbooks, and incident response procedures.  
  • Support the redesign of policies and controls aligned with Zero Trust principles, regulatory requirements, and internal governance standards.  
  • Provide technical leadership to project teams, partner resources, and client teams, including knowledge transfer, quality assurance, and issue resolution.  
  • Track delivery milestones, risks, assumptions, and decisions, and communicate progress clearly to senior leadership. 

Mandatory Requirements  


  • 8+ years of experience in cybersecurity consulting, security architecture, or security transformation programs.  
  • Proven experience leading large-scale security migrations or platform transformations in enterprise environments.  
  • Strong expertise in Google security technologies, including Google Cloud security architecture, Google SecOps, Mandiant capabilities, Chrome Enterprise security controls, Workspace security, IAM, and cloud-native monitoring and response capabilities.  
  • Strong hands-on knowledge of Microsoft security technologies, including Entra ID, Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Office 365, Defender for Identity, Defender for Cloud Apps, Sentinel, Purview, and Intune.  
  • Experience designing security controls across identity, endpoint, cloud, SaaS, data protection, SIEM/SOAR, vulnerability management, and incident response domains.  
  • Experience with Zero Trust architecture, security governance, regulatory compliance, and enterprise risk management.  
  • Strong program and project leadership skills, including stakeholder management, workshops facilitation, planning, and cross-functional team coordination.  
  • Fluent English, with excellent verbal and written communication skills. 

Additional Information  


  • Employment type: CLT (full-time employee) with flexible benefits  
  • Work model: Remote  
  • English fluency is mandatory; CV must be submitted in English.

Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de QA Automação Sênior (Java) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Na Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global.


Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!

Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

O que esperamos que você realize:

  • Desenvolver, manter e evoluir frameworks e scripts de automação de testes para APIs e aplicações.
  • Elaborar cenários de testes utilizando BDD (Behavior Driven Development), garantindo clareza e rastreabilidade dos requisitos.
  • Participar ativamente das cerimônias ágeis, contribuindo com a visão de qualidade desde o refinamento até a entrega das funcionalidades.

  • Identificar, registrar, acompanhar e apoiar a resolução de defeitos em conjunto com os times de desenvolvimento.
  • Apoiar a evolução dos processos de qualidade, integração contínua e automação de pipelines.
  • Promover boas práticas de testes automatizados, governança, rastreabilidade e melhoria contínua.
  • Contribuir para a disseminação da cultura de qualidade dentro dos times de tecnologia.

Requisitos e qualificações

O que precisamos que você tenha de conhecimento:

  • Experiência sólida (mínimo de 4 anos) com automação de testes utilizando Java.
  • Experiência em automação de testes para APIs REST.
  • Vivência com BDD utilizando Cucumber.
  • Conhecimento em JUnit 5.
  • Experiência com REST Assured para validação de APIs.
  • Conhecimento em Git para versionamento de código.
  • Experiência com Maven para gerenciamento de dependências.
  • Vivência com pipelines de Integração e Entrega Contínua (CI/CD).
  • Capacidade de elaborar cenários de testes claros, objetivos e bem documentados em português.
  • Conhecimento de boas práticas de qualidade de software, automação de testes e engenharia de qualidade.


Stacks

  • Java
  • JUnit 5
  • Cucumber BDD
  • REST Assured
  • Playwright
  • Allure Reports
  • Docker
  • Git
  • GitLab CI


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com Playwright para automação de interfaces web.
  • Conhecimento em testes de integração utilizando Mock Server.
  • Vivência em projetos dos segmentos financeiro, crédito ou meios de pagamento.
  • Experiência com Docker e ambientes conteinerizados.
  • Conhecimento em geração, análise e manutenção de relatórios Allure.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de IA aplicadas ao desenvolvimento e testes, como Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity e OpenCode.
  • Experiência em ambientes orientados à arquitetura de microsserviços.

title: Subject Matter Expert - Finance
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Subject Matter Expert - Finance em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

We’re hiring finance professionals who know AP, AR, accounting close, or finance systems inside-out — and want to help shape how AI understands finance workflows.

In this role, you’ll use your real-world experience with QuickBooks, Bill.com, and Concur to create realistic finance scenarios, evaluate AI outputs, and improve the accuracy of next-generation AI systems.


What does day-to-day life look like?

  • Create finance workflow prompts and real-world accounting scenarios
  • Review and evaluate AI-generated responses for accuracy and reasoning
  • Build synthetic invoices, bills, reconciliations, and GL datasets
  • Identify edge cases such as duplicate bills, sync failures, policy violations, and GAAP errors
  • Help improve AI performance across finance operations and controls


We're looking for:

Professionals with hands-on experience in one or more of the following:

  • Accounts Payable
  • Accounts Receivable
  • Accounting & Month-End Close
  • Controller / Finance Management
  • Finance Systems Administration


Requirements:

  • 4–12 years of finance/accounting experience
  • Strong working knowledge of QuickBooks, Bill.com, and/or Concur
  • Understanding of US GAAP and finance controls
  • Excellent written communication skills
  • Comfortable using AI tools like ChatGPT or Claude
  • CPA/CMA preferred (required for Controller-level roles)


Nice to have:

  • Experience with AI evaluation, RLHF, or LLM projects
  • ERP migrations, multi-entity or multi-currency exposure
  • Basic Python or SQL skills


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Work at the intersection of Finance + AI
  • Influence how AI systems reason about accounting workflows


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: 40 hours per week with overlap of 4 hours with PST.
  • Engagement Type: Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 4 weeks; (expected start date is next week)

title: Gerente de FP&A e Controladoria Global
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Gerente de FP&A e Controladoria Global em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

O Grupo Nuveto está em busca de um(a) Gerente Global de FP&A e Controladoria para liderar a governança financeira, a consolidação contábil e o planejamento financeiro das operações do grupo em múltiplos países. Essa posição terá como missão garantir a confiabilidade e a conformidade das informações financeiras, fortalecer os controles e processos corporativos, além de transformar dados financeiros e operacionais em análises estratégicas que apoiem a tomada de decisão da liderança, impulsionando o crescimento sustentável, a rentabilidade e a escalabilidade do negócio.



Responsabilidades

  • Fechamento Contábil;
  • Coordenar o processo de fechamento contábil mensal, trimestral e anual, garantindo cumprimento de prazos e qualidade das informações;
  • Supervisionar a conciliação de contas e a consistência dos lançamentos contábeis entre as unidades do grupo;
  • Gerenciar o processo de consolidação das demonstrações financeiras das entidades multipaíses, incluindo eliminações intercompany;
  • Assegurar a correta apuração de resultados por unidade de negócio e por país, suportando a visão segmentada da liderança;
  • Ser o ponto de contato principal com auditores externos, coordenando a entrega de informações e suporte às auditorias. Conformidade e Políticas Internas;
  • Garantir a aderência das operações financeiras às políticas internas do grupo, normas contábeis (CPC/IFRS) e requisitos regulatórios de cada país;
  • Desenvolver, documentar e revisar políticas e procedimentos de controladoria, promovendo padronização entre as unidades;
  • Monitorar controles internos financeiros, identificando gaps e implementando melhorias para mitigar riscos operacionais;
  • Suportar processos de due diligence e revisões internas, garantindo a integridade e rastreabilidade das informações financeiras;
  • Assegurar que os processos de aprovação, alçadas e segregação de funções estejam implementados e operacionais. Relatórios Gerenciais e FP&A;
  • Elaborar e evoluir continuamente o pacote de relatórios gerenciais mensais (management report) para o CFO, CEO e board;
  • Construir análises de variância entre realizado e orçado (actual vs. budget / forecast), identificando desvios e propondo planos de ação em conjunto com as áreas de negócio;
  • Apoiar o processo de orçamento anual (budget) e revisões de forecast, garantindo a consistência entre as premissas contábeis e financeiras;
  • Desenvolver dashboards e indicadores financeiros relevantes para o modelo SaaS: MRR, ARR, Churn, CAC, LTV e Rule of 40;
  • Traduzir dados contábeis em insights acionáveis para a liderança, conectando a visão financeira à estratégia do negócio.


Qualificações

  • Graduação em Ciências Contábeis, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência sólida em controladoria com foco em fechamento contábil, relatórios gerenciais e conformidade;
  • Vivência com operações em múltiplos países e consolidação de demonstrações financeiras intercompany;
  • Domínio do ERP TOTVS (Protheus ou Datasul), especialmente nos módulos Contábil e Financeiro;
  • Conhecimento de normas contábeis brasileiras (CPC/IFRS) e experiência com consolidação de demonstrações financeiras;
  • Experiência na elaboração de relatórios gerenciais e análises de variância (budget vs. actual);
  • Inglês intermediário / avançado para comunicação com entidades internacionais


O que esperamos de você:


  • Capacidade de atuar de forma colaborativa, construindo relacionamentos de confiança e promovendo a integração entre diferentes áreas e países.
  • Forte visão analítica para interpretar dados financeiros e operacionais, identificar tendências, antecipar riscos e apoiar decisões estratégicas.
  • Perfil de liderança, com habilidade para influenciar stakeholders, conduzir projetos complexos;
  • Proatividade para identificar oportunidades de melhoria, simplificar processos e fortalecer a governança financeira da organização;
  • Comunicação clara e objetiva, sendo capaz de traduzir informações financeiras complexas em insights relevantes para diferentes públicos;
  • Orientação para resultados, conciliando excelência técnica, visão de negócio e foco na geração de valor para a companhia;


Diferenciais que somam pontos:

  • Conhecimento de estruturação de dados e governança


Benefícios

  • Vale Refeição (Flash Benefícios);
  • Recesso
  • Day Off no aniversário;
  • Total Pass;
  • Convênio Médico e Odontológico;


Modelo: Pessoa Jurídica

Jornada: Segunda a sexta

Salário: A combinar


Nossa Cultura:

Crescemos com base em quatro pilares: Foco em Resultados, Compromisso com o Cliente, Inovação Contínua e Relacionamentos Transparentes.

Aqui, você encontra um ambiente dinâmico, colaborativo e inovador, onde ideias ganham espaço e cada pessoa tem a oportunidade de fazer a diferença.

Venha fazer parte desse time!

title: AI Quality Analyst (Portgugal Portuguese )
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Quality Analyst (Portgugal Portuguese ) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Description:

MillionLogics is a trusted Oracle Partner and global leader in IT solutions, with operations in London, UK, and a development hub in Hyderabad, India. Specialising in innovative and scalable services, MillionLogics empowers enterprises through data & AI, cloud solutions, IT consulting, and custom application development. With a team of 85+ AI/ML experts, we deliver tailored solutions that foster digital transformation and operational excellence. We are committed to client success. We blend world-class technical expertise with strategic insight to deliver results.


Role Overview:

As an AI quality analyst, you will evaluate a new personalisation feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigour. You will actively design prompts from your personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalised responses, evaluating dimensions such as grounding, integration, and helpfulness.


Offer Details:

  • Duration of Contract : 12 months
  • Pay: $1500 per month (net/take-home)
  • Mode of work: Fully Remote
  • Number of Positions: 20
  • Must have fluency in Portugal Portuguese (not Brazilian Portuguese)



Key Qualifications:

  • Portuguese Proficiency : Ability to read and write in Portugal Portuguese (not Brazilian Portuguese) with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project.
  • Personal Account Usage: Willing to use computer science, primary personal Google account (not a testing account), and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate the ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalisation quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalisation concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalisation, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and over-narrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalised AI interactions. Your day-to-day work will involve:
  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilise your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalisation was appropriately applied.
  • Analysing responses for grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"over-narrating\".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilised.
  • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.

description:

About the role:  

We are seeking a senior-level professional with strong expertise in cybersecurity architecture and advisory, with proven experience in large-scale security transformation programs. 

This individual will be responsible for leading both technically and strategically the migration between security platforms, acting as an advisor, architect, and program leader. 


A strong end-to-end vision of enterprise security is essential, along with deep knowledge of Microsoft and Google environments, and the ability to drive decisions in complex, global environments. 

Responsibilities  


  • Lead and advise the end-to-end migration strategy from Microsoft security tools to Google security tools, including current state assessment, future architecture design, roadmap creation, sequencing, and transition execution.  
  • Assess and map Microsoft security capabilities such as Entra ID, Defender, Sentinel, Purview, and Intune to relevant Google capabilities, including Google Cloud security services, Google SecOps, Mandiant, Chrome Enterprise, Google Workspace security, and identity and access controls.  
  • Define migration waves, dependencies, technical designs, and coexistence models to minimize business disruption and maintain security coverage throughout the transition.  
  • Design and oversee implementation of controls across identity, endpoint, cloud security, data protection, security operations, threat detection, incident response, posture management, and governance.  
  • Lead workshops with stakeholders from security, infrastructure, cloud, workspace, compliance, and executive leadership to align requirements, risks, architectural decisions, and operating model changes.  
  • Develop security architecture documentation, migration runbooks, control mappings, risk registers, executive committee updates, and implementation plans.  
  • Guide the integration of Google telemetry, detection content, and security workflows into Security Operations processes, including use cases, alerts, playbooks, and incident response procedures.  
  • Support the redesign of policies and controls aligned with Zero Trust principles, regulatory requirements, and internal governance standards.  
  • Provide technical leadership to project teams, partner resources, and client teams, including knowledge transfer, quality assurance, and issue resolution.  
  • Track delivery milestones, risks, assumptions, and decisions, and communicate progress clearly to senior leadership. 

Mandatory Requirements  


  • 8+ years of experience in cybersecurity consulting, security architecture, or security transformation programs.  
  • Proven experience leading large-scale security migrations or platform transformations in enterprise environments.  
  • Strong expertise in Google security technologies, including Google Cloud security architecture, Google SecOps, Mandiant capabilities, Chrome Enterprise security controls, Workspace security, IAM, and cloud-native monitoring and response capabilities.  
  • Strong hands-on knowledge of Microsoft security technologies, including Entra ID, Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Office 365, Defender for Identity, Defender for Cloud Apps, Sentinel, Purview, and Intune.  
  • Experience designing security controls across identity, endpoint, cloud, SaaS, data protection, SIEM/SOAR, vulnerability management, and incident response domains.  
  • Experience with Zero Trust architecture, security governance, regulatory compliance, and enterprise risk management.  
  • Strong program and project leadership skills, including stakeholder management, workshops facilitation, planning, and cross-functional team coordination.  
  • Fluent English, with excellent verbal and written communication skills. 

Additional Information  


  • Employment type: CLT (full-time employee) with flexible benefits  
  • Work model: Remote  
  • English fluency is mandatory; CV must be submitted in English.

title: Senior Google Security Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Google Security Specialist em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the role:  

We are seeking a senior-level professional with strong expertise in cybersecurity architecture and advisory, with proven experience in large-scale security transformation programs. 

This individual will be responsible for leading both technically and strategically the migration between security platforms, acting as an advisor, architect, and program leader. 


A strong end-to-end vision of enterprise security is essential, along with deep knowledge of Microsoft and Google environments, and the ability to drive decisions in complex, global environments. 

Responsibilities  


  • Lead and advise the end-to-end migration strategy from Microsoft security tools to Google security tools, including current state assessment, future architecture design, roadmap creation, sequencing, and transition execution.  
  • Assess and map Microsoft security capabilities such as Entra ID, Defender, Sentinel, Purview, and Intune to relevant Google capabilities, including Google Cloud security services, Google SecOps, Mandiant, Chrome Enterprise, Google Workspace security, and identity and access controls.  
  • Define migration waves, dependencies, technical designs, and coexistence models to minimize business disruption and maintain security coverage throughout the transition.  
  • Design and oversee implementation of controls across identity, endpoint, cloud security, data protection, security operations, threat detection, incident response, posture management, and governance.  
  • Lead workshops with stakeholders from security, infrastructure, cloud, workspace, compliance, and executive leadership to align requirements, risks, architectural decisions, and operating model changes.  
  • Develop security architecture documentation, migration runbooks, control mappings, risk registers, executive committee updates, and implementation plans.  
  • Guide the integration of Google telemetry, detection content, and security workflows into Security Operations processes, including use cases, alerts, playbooks, and incident response procedures.  
  • Support the redesign of policies and controls aligned with Zero Trust principles, regulatory requirements, and internal governance standards.  
  • Provide technical leadership to project teams, partner resources, and client teams, including knowledge transfer, quality assurance, and issue resolution.  
  • Track delivery milestones, risks, assumptions, and decisions, and communicate progress clearly to senior leadership. 

Mandatory Requirements  


  • 8+ years of experience in cybersecurity consulting, security architecture, or security transformation programs.  
  • Proven experience leading large-scale security migrations or platform transformations in enterprise environments.  
  • Strong expertise in Google security technologies, including Google Cloud security architecture, Google SecOps, Mandiant capabilities, Chrome Enterprise security controls, Workspace security, IAM, and cloud-native monitoring and response capabilities.  
  • Strong hands-on knowledge of Microsoft security technologies, including Entra ID, Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Office 365, Defender for Identity, Defender for Cloud Apps, Sentinel, Purview, and Intune.  
  • Experience designing security controls across identity, endpoint, cloud, SaaS, data protection, SIEM/SOAR, vulnerability management, and incident response domains.  
  • Experience with Zero Trust architecture, security governance, regulatory compliance, and enterprise risk management.  
  • Strong program and project leadership skills, including stakeholder management, workshops facilitation, planning, and cross-functional team coordination.  
  • Fluent English, with excellent verbal and written communication skills. 

Additional Information  


  • Employment type: CLT (full-time employee) with flexible benefits  
  • Work model: Remote  
  • English fluency is mandatory; CV must be submitted in English.

Principais Responsabilidades


  • Arquitetura e Desenvolvimento: Projetar e desenvolver aplicações full stack de alta complexidade, implementando padrões de arquitetura definidos e garantindo a consistência do código.
  • Desenvolvimento de Módulos Core (RH/DP):
  • Criar fluxos de Admissão automatizados e seguros.
  • Construir e manter o motor de cálculo da Folha de Pagamento e Rescisões, garantindo precisão absoluta.
  • Desenvolver a gestão de Férias e o processamento de marcações de Ponto Eletrônico.
  • Legislação e Integrações: Traduzir regras da CLT e acordos sindicais em lógicas de sistema. Criar integrações robustas com sistemas bancários, APIs contábeis e órgãos governamentais (ex: e-Social), além de atuar no design de APIs (REST).
  • Liderança e Mentoria: Mentorar desenvolvedores(as) de nível pleno e júnior, realizando code reviews construtivos e disseminando boas práticas de mercado.
  • Automação e Qualidade: Garantir a qualidade através da implementação de uma estratégia sólida de testes automatizados (unitários, integração, e2e) e utilizar ativamente ferramentas de IA para geração de código, visando produtividade.
  • Infraestrutura e Deploy: Trabalhar com Docker para manter ambientes consistentes e atuar ativamente em esteiras de CI/CD para entregas contínuas.



Formação e Experiência


  • Experiência Específica em RH: Experiência comprovada na construção de sistemas de Recursos Humanos (HCM/HRMS), Departamento Pessoal, Workforce Management (ponto/escalas) ou plataformas de processamento financeiro complexo.
  • Experiência Técnica: Sólida vivência em desenvolvimento full stack corporativo, atuando de ponta a ponta na concepção de produtos.
  • Metodologias: Sólida vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) em times de produto, além de entendimento claro de workflows como GitFlow.

  • Stack Principal: Domínio avançado do ecossistema Node.js (NestJS, Express) e React (incluindo Next.js). Familiaridade com TypeScript e Vue.js.
  • Bancos de Dados: Proficiência em bancos relacionais (PostgreSQL, MySQL), ORMs, modelagem de tabelas e entendimento profundo de DER, além de transações consistentes.
  • DevOps & Cloud: Excelente conhecimento em Docker e ambiente Linux. Vivência prática com provedores Cloud (GCP, Azure) e cultura DevOps (CI/CD).
  • Ferramentas: Proficiência com Git/GitHub e experiência no uso de ferramentas de IA assistiva (como Claude Code ou similares).

title: Talent Acquisition Partner
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Talent Acquisition Partner em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Talent Acquisition Partner (Active Sourcing)


Location: Fully Remote (Must be based in LATAM)

Job Type: Full-Time



About Uproot Clean

Uproot Clean is a fast-growing consumer products company with more than 5 million customers using our products. Our products are sold not only through DTC and Amazon, but also through major retailers, including Walmart, Target, and Petco, along with more than 10,000 retail doors across the country. Uproot has also been featured across major television and media platforms, including QVC, Good Morning America, and Fox, helping introduce millions of consumers to the brand.

We care deeply about building products that genuinely solve problems for pet owners while operating with high standards across every part of the business. We are building a company focused on long-term excellence, creating significant opportunities for highly capable people who want real and meaningful impact, and the ability to help shape the future of the company.

About the Role

This is a hands-on execution role focused 100% on active sourcing. You will proactively identify and engage high-quality talent across multiple functions and seniority levels using multiple sourcing channels, advanced search techniques, and thoughtful outreach.

Success requires high-output execution, strong judgment, persistence, excellent communication, and the ability to operate with urgency in a fast-moving environment.



Responsibilities


Active Sourcing

  • Proactively source candidates across multiple job boards, platforms, and sourcing channels
  • Use advanced Boolean search techniques to identify strong talent
  • Build pipelines across multiple functions and seniority levels
  • Identify strong passive candidates
  • Partner closely with recruiting and hiring managers to align on hiring needs.

Candidate Outreach

  • Write outbound messaging that drives candidate engagement
  • Qualify candidates early in the process
  • Move qualified candidates into the recruiting workflow

Pipeline Management

  • Maintain organized sourcing workflows and candidate tracking
  • Continuously improve sourcing strategies and outreach quality
  • Continuously iterate on sourcing methods, messaging, and targeting

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistently builds high-quality candidate pipelines
  • Surfaces strong candidates quickly across multiple functions
  • Generates strong response and assessment completion rates
  • Operates with speed, consistency, and minimal oversight
  • Raises the overall talent bar of the company over time


Requirements

Must Have

  • 1+ year of full-time active sourcing experience - mandatory
  • Experience sourcing across multiple job boards and sourcing platforms
  • Strong outbound recruiting and candidate outreach skills
  • Experience using advanced Boolean search techniques
  • Excellent written English communication skills
  • Ability to manage multiple open searches simultaneously

Strong Plus

  • Experience sourcing across multiple functions and seniority levels
  • Experience in high-growth, e-commerce, or performance-driven companies
  • Familiarity with LinkedIn Recruiter and modern sourcing tools

Work Requirements

⏰ Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST

Workspace: Fixed, professional setup (no digital nomads)

Output: Daily briefs and feedback loops (high consistency required)


Who This Role Is For (& Not For)

This Role Is For You If:

  • You enjoy the challenge of finding exceptional people before anyone else does
  • You are naturally proactive and internally driven
  • You move quickly, stay organized, and maintain high standards
  • You enjoy performance-oriented environments with accountability
  • You think recruiting is a high-leverage business function, not administrative work
  • You enjoy improving systems, processes, and sourcing quality over time

This Role Is NOT For You If:

  • You need constant direction or external motivation
  • You struggle with consistency and follow-through
  • You are uncomfortable persuading passive candidates
  • You treat recruiting as scheduling and coordination only


Compensation & Benefits

Uproot Clean is a high ownership, high accountability environment with high standards for communication, speed, execution, and quality. We care far more about ability, judgment, and ownership than credentials or years of experience.

  • Salary : Competitive base salary + performance-based bonus structure
  • Significant autonomy with the ability to directly influence the company’s growth and direction
  • Fully remote : work from anywhere
  • PTO : 2 Weeks
  • Flex Day : An additional quarterly day off dedicated to rest and recovery
  • Thinking Day: one dedicated day each quarter to step away from day-to-day execution and think deeply about your role, systems, ideas, and long-term impact
  • Wellness Reimbursement: $100-$300/month, based on location, to help support your wellness.
  • Pet Reimbursement: $40-100/month, based on location to help support parenting a pet.
  • Coaching credits: $1,000+/year for coaching, education, and professional development


Ready to Apply?

If you are excited by high standards, proactive recruiting, and the challenge of building world-class talent pipelines, we’d love to hear from you.

Required

About the Company

We are a leading digital asset platform that provides trading, brokerage, custody, and infrastructure solutions for institutional and professional investors. As the business continues to grow, they are seeking an experienced liquidity professional to lead and enhance their global liquidity capabilities.


Role Overview

This leadership role is responsible for overseeing liquidity strategy across digital asset and FX markets in LATAM, ensuring efficient market access, strong execution quality, and robust liquidity coverage across trading products. The successful candidate will work closely with Trading, Sales, Product, Risk, Compliance, Treasury, and Technology teams to support the firm's institutional trading business. Key Responsibilities

Liquidity Management

  • Develop and execute the firm's liquidity strategy across digital asset and FX-related markets.
  • Source, onboard, and manage relationships with liquidity providers, market makers, brokers, exchanges, and banking partners.
  • Monitor liquidity quality, market depth, pricing competitiveness, and venue performance.

FX & Trading Operations

  • Oversee liquidity and execution across FX and digital asset trading flows.
  • Monitor market developments and identify opportunities to improve execution performance and pricing.

Risk & Governance

Leadership & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Lead and develop the liquidity function.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders across Trading, Treasury, Product, Technology, Risk, and Compliance teams.
  • Provide management reporting on liquidity performance, market developments, and strategic initiatives.


Requirements

  • Significant experience in liquidity management, electronic trading, FX trading, market structure, market making, brokerage, or institutional trading environments.
  • Experience sourcing, evaluating, and managing relationships with liquidity providers, brokers, market makers, exchanges, and banking partners.
  • Strong understanding of FX and/or digital asset liquidity ecosystems and execution practices.
  • Ability to analyze execution quality, transaction costs, and liquidity performance metrics.
  • Commercially minded with strong negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience working within regulated financial services environments.
  • Excellent communication, leadership, and relationship management capabilities.

  • Teams

  • OneDrive

  • Entra ID

They should be able to guide conversations, challenge designs, make informed decisions, and work effectively with senior Azure engineers.

title: Integration Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Integration Engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Product

Anterior is on a mission to transform healthcare administration, making it seamless and invisible so clinicians can focus on delivering care. We’ve built an AI-powered platform designed by clinicians, for clinicians, to simplify administrative workflows and improve patient outcomes. By combining clinical expertise with cutting-edge technology, we’re revolutionizing healthcare operations with responsible AI.

We’re growing rapidly and are backed by world-class investors including Sequoia, New Enterprise Associates NEA, and Neo along with notable angels including the founders of DeepMind, Google AI, and Inflection AI.

Anterior is improving the experience of healthcare for everyone. We’re working on the cutting edge of using technology to make clinical decision-making frictionless.We’re building exciting tech for huge customers and we trust in the foundations: keep it simple, build strong foundations, and the rest will follow.


The Team

At Anterior, engineers share a strong “sense of product” and solve meaningful problems that simplify healthcare workflows. We collaborate in multidisciplinary teams to deliver secure, scalable, and user-focused solutions guided by best practices and modular design.

We’re building a dedicated deployments team focused on deploying our platform into large US enterprise healthcare environments. This team works closely with customers and our core platform engineers to ensure seamless, reliable integrations into complex payer systems of record.


About You

You have a passion for doing things The Right Way, you believe Less is More, you want to focus on the foundations of system design and architecture (pacelc, consistency guarantees), you care as much about the code you do not write, you’re tired of the hype treadmill and care about the fundamentals. You have battle scars from over-engineered and underperforming slop, and you care about writing code that lasts.

Your depth is in building integrations, APIs, and data pipelines that connect complex systems together reliably. You’ve worked with enterprise customers, dealt with messy data, conflicting sources of truth, and deduplication challenges.

You’ve owned integration design decisions end-to-end — from scoping requirements with a customer to shipping it to production and making sure it holds up. You may be coming from a health tech company, a scale-up doing enterprise deployments, or a platform team that built the connective tissue between systems — what matters is that you’ve navigated real integration complexity and you want ownership over what you build.


About the Role

Members of Technical Staff (Deployments) at Anterior own customer deployment problems end-to-end — from scoping integrations through to production. You’ll be the bridge between our AI platform and the enterprise healthcare systems it plugs into.

A day’s work may include:

  • Designing and building integrations, APIs, and data pipelines that connect our platform to customer systems of record EHRs, claims platforms, care management systems)
  • Working directly with US enterprise healthcare customers to understand their architecture, scope integration requirements, and translate them into technical specs
  • Building and maintaining FHIR, HL7, and custom API integrations with payer and health plan systems
  • Debugging data quality issues — conflicting sources of truth, deduplication, schema mismatches, and edge cases specific to healthcare data
  • Owning UAT testing end-to-end, working with customer IT teams to validate data flows before go-live
  • Building internal tooling and shared integration patterns that make the next deployment faster
  • Contributing to Anterior’s SDKs, developer documentation, and integration playbooks
  • Collaborating closely with the core platform team in New York to ensure integration needs inform platform architecture


Tech

  • Langs: Python / TS
  • Infra: Nix, AWS
  • Healthcare data: FHIR, HL7 (experience preferred but not required — you’ll learn fast if you have strong API and data pipeline fundamentals)


What we’re looking for

  • Strong backend engineering fundamentals — APIs, data pipelines, distributed systems
  • Experience integrating with enterprise systems, ideally in healthcare (payer, EHR, claims) but complex enterprise integrations in other industries count too
  • Comfort working directly with customers and translating ambiguous requirements into clean technical solutions
  • Experience with data quality challenges — deduplication, schema mapping, reconciliation across multiple sources of truth
  • Strong written and spoken communication in English — you’ll be collaborating with teams and customers across time zones
  • Ability to work autonomously from detailed technical specs while flagging blockers and ambiguity early
  • Timezone compatibility with US East Coast ET) working hours


What’s in it for you

This is an opportunity to join a company at its major inflection point, using cutting- edge technology to have a meaningful impact in healthcare. You’ll work with a world-class team, hold significant responsibility, and have the opportunity to learn and grow rapidly.


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule).
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.


As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.

title: Analista De Qualidade
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista De Qualidade em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Graduação em Engenharia Civil, Arquitetura, Tecnólogo em Construção Civil ou áreas correlatas.Desejável especialização em Gestão da Qualidade.Experiência em obras de construção civil imobiliária, inspeção e controle de serviços, recebimento e controle tecnológico de materiais, gestão de não conformidades, auditorias, acompanhamento de indicadores e sistemas de gestão da qualidade.Conhecimento em PBQP-H SiAC, ISO 9001, interpretação de projetos, procedimentos executivos, ferramentas da qualidade e melhoria contínua.Desejável conhecimento em Power BI, Excel avançado, sistemas de gestão de obras, análise de dados e utilização de ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial para ganho de produtividade e gestão da informação.Responsabilidades:Atuar no corporativo apoiando a gestão da qualidade das obras, garantindo a implementação, manutenção e melhoria contínua dos processos do Sistema de Gestão Integrada e dos requisitos do PBQP-H SiAC e ISO 9001.Realizar monitoramento de indicadores, elaboração de relatórios gerenciais, análises críticas, auditorias internas, gestão de não conformidades e acompanhamento dos planos de ação corporativos.Prestar suporte técnico às equipes de qualidade das obras, promovendo padronização de processos, capacitação das equipes, acompanhamento de inspeções, controle tecnológico, gestão documental e disseminação das melhores práticas.Apoiar a implantação de ferramentas digitais, dashboards gerenciais, Power BI e soluções de Inteligência Artificial voltadas para aumento da eficiência operacional, análise de dados e tomada de decisão.Atuar de forma integrada com as áreas de Engenharia, Produção, Planejamento, Segurança e Incorporação, contribuindo para a evolução da maturidade dos processos e dos resultados corporativos.

title: Gerente Distrital De Vendas
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Gerente Distrital De Vendas em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job DescriptionEstamos buscando um(a) Gerente Distrital de Vendas. Você se identifica com ambiente dinâmico, com empresas em momento de startup que proporcionam alto potencial de crescimento profissional?Estamos em busca de Pessoas Campeãs que queiram se desafiar e estar conosco para alçar voos cada vez mais altos!Responsabilidades:Liderando um time direto, fica responsável pelos Canais de Distribuição, Redes e Território (Canal Independente)Responsável pelo desenvolvimento das capacidades funcionais e competências do time, através das ferramentas disponibilizadas pela cia; Ser corresponsável na definição de um GTM de vendas otimizada, eficiente e rentável para o cumprimento dos objetivos traçados;  Identificando lacunas nas áreas de cobertura dentro do território e avaliando oportunidades de investimento em cobertura. (Gestão de White Space); Gerir Sell In, Sell Out, Estoques e política comercial dos Canais de Redes e Distribuição; Implementar, acompanhar e apoiar os planos (JBPs) dos parceiros de Distribuição e Redes; Redes: Implementar, acompanhar e Liderar as estratégias dos trimestres para a ativação do portfólio de marcas em coordenando a execução das equipes de Venda incluindo política de varejo, planos de clientes por UF, DOH da UF; Assegurar a execução do plano de ativação em linha com o orçamento, atuando rapidamente no caso de ações corretivas e influenciando todas as áreas envolvidas no alcance dos resultados; Canal Independente (Território): Desenvolver, o canal do varejo independente através de um time de 2 gestores e mais de 20 executivos, buscando atingir a melhor distribuição numérica, faturamento, mix e evolução dos itens prioritários (lançamentos); Requisitos:Ensino Superior Completo (Cursos de exatas: Engenharias, Economia, Física, Estatísticas, Matemática, Adm e etc.,); Pós graduação (Diferencial)Experiência Comercial (Indústrias de bens de consumo - indispensável); Experiência em liderança de times comerciais (indispensável); Experiência no Canal indireto Distribuição FMCG (indispensável).Informações adicionais:Benefícios:Plano Médico e Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida;Ticket Refeição; Veículo;Cartão combustívelPPRBuscamos pessoas que querem colocar a mão na massa e fazer acontecer para tornar as empresas do Grupo referência em inovação e no cuidado com as pessoas. Vem ser Grupo NC você também!SOMOS LEGRANDHá mais de 40 anos no mercado farmacêutico, o Legrand Pharma está entre os 15 maiores laboratórios do país (unidades). Com um amplo portfólio de produtos (mais de 300 apresentações), atua no segmento de OTCs, tarjados e genéricos, presente em mais de 90% das farmácias brasileiras com forte atuação nas categorias de tosse, gastrointestinal, vitaminas, dermatológicos e saúde feminina.
